title: Cute Rabbit's Challenging Adventure
description: Accompany the cute rabbit's adventure together and have fun. I think it will be a little difficult to progress on the challenging tracks consisting of 5 sections in total. Avoid dangers and destroy enemies. Overcome obstacles and have fun times.

title: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly
description: This is a first-person psychological horror game where you work night shifts in a small street kiosk. What seems like a normal job quickly turns into a nightmare: customers grow increasingly strange, and reality itself begins to warp. Some people just want to eat — others are only pretending to be human.

title: Murder Stone Age
description: Test your instincts in Murder Stone Age, a suspenseful tap-based thriller. Watch your back as mysterious figures follow you. One of them may mean harm. Tap to glance behind just in time: guess wrong and it's over. Can you outwit the stalker and survive?

title: Fish Jam
description: This game is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts. The fish is trapped on the beach, and you need to come up with a reasonable moving plan to release the fish one by one from the crowded scene. Strategize to free the trapped fish on the beach, testing your problem-solving skills. With numerous levels that increase in difficulty, it's a great way to pass the time.

title: Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve
description: Embark on a Brain-Twisting Journey with Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve, an exceptional wood puzzle game about nuts and bolts to test your IQ brain power. For nuts and bolts lovers who likes challenge and innovative gameplay, the right game for you - the ultimate puzzle game - is here.

title: Sniper Wars: Find the Criminal
description: The snipers have begun the battle! Find the villain among the crowd of citizens and eliminate him. Take a rifle and go on a dangerous mission to find the criminal! You have a photo of the criminal and a rifle, find him and eliminate him!

title: Fillwords: Find All the Words
description:
Fillwords: Find All the Words - the ultimate word search puzzle for intellectuals and word game enthusiasts! Find the hidden words in the grid of letters. Train your brain, boost your memory, and expand your vocabulary.

Various Themes, every time different word combinations
Enjoy a vibrant and intuitive interface
Use hints
Offline Play: Enjoy the game without the internet connection
Vocabulary enrichment
Suitable for all ages

title: Hotfoot Baseball
description:
Simple baseball game with fun, cartoony players and easy one-click controls. It’s fast to learn and fun to play!

Unlike other baseball games, the action doesn’t stop after you hit the ball. You need to decide when to run, move to the next base, and try to score runs. It’s all about timing and quick decisions.

Pick one of the best baseball countries and try to win the championship. The game keeps the excitement of baseball but with simple rules, so anyone can enjoy it.

title: Stickman The Flash
description: Stickman The Flash is a fighting RPG arcade game with 2D stickman warriors. In the Survival Mode, you need to survive as long as you can by dodging red areas and killing incoming enemies. You can collect different weapons when you kill the corresponding enemies. When you earn enough gems, you can unlock and equip them in the Equipment Store, and they will increase your full abilities. Keep calm and slaughter them all!

title: Bubble it jam
description: Bubble it jam is a vibrant, fast-paced puzzle-shooter game where players aim and shoot colored balls to match and pop clusters of the same color.the goal is to collect color bubble, free the ropes, and complete each level. Every stage presents a new and exciting challenge, keeping gameplay fresh and engaging, combining strategy, quick reflexes, and a bit of luck for high scores.

title: Untwist Road
description: Collect cylinders, roll out the road and overcome obstacles in this unique game. It is suitable for all fans of arcade games who like to test their skills and reactions. Try all the features of the game, unlock new levels and beat your records! You only need a few minutes to fully immerse yourself in this exciting game. Try it yourself!

title: Pumpkin Catcher
description:
Fly on a jetpack between walls and avoid rotating traps. Catch pumpkins using your favorite monster: zombie, vampire, devil or even a cat!

Try this challenging Halloween game and set a new world record in catching pumpkins. Compete with your friends on the online leaderboard! Collect them all!

title: Limited Kaboom
description:
Use your buddies to take down the enemy structures and the enemies along with them! 
Can you make survive the hero? 
Use the physics of the world to skillfully take down Sam's enemies!

title: Butterfly Triple
description:
Butterfly Tripple is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you merge cute butterflies!
Place the shapes on the board so that three or more butterflies of the same color touch each other. When they connect, they’re released and gracefully fly away. Vivid graphics, smooth animations, and a cozy atmosphere make the game a true pleasure to play.

title: Candy Pop Mania
description:
Dive into the enchanting world of matching games - Candy Pop Mania - where delightful fun and challenging games await! Pop, blast and match 3 sweets to keep on the adventure! Use combos and reach the best results!
Challenge yourself to win all of the levels of Candy Pop Mania!

title: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic
description: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle game where you clear the board by pairing identical tiles. Play a new puzzle every day, unlock missed days with ads, and keep your weekly streak for exciting rewards! Track your progress in the Weekly Record, where you can challenge yourself to beat your All-Time Best Score. Enjoy smooth gameplay, balanced difficulty from easy to hard, and use helpful boosters like Hint, Shuffle, and Undo to master every layout.

title: Sigil Seeker
description: Welcome to Sigil Seeker!\nEmbark on a quest to collect mystical sigils by tapping tiles on the screen. Add tiles to your row, aiming to gather three identical sigils to collect them. Your goal is to gather all the sigils before time runs out. But beware, if your row overflows or the clock reaches zero, the game is over.\nAre you ready to become the ultimate Sigil Seeker? Dive in and start your adventure now!

title: Checkers Deluxe Edition
description:
It's a clash on the battlefield! Draw up your plan and defeat your opponents with finesse!

It is also known as the draughts game, and it is an interesting test of strategy. Compete with an opponent and dominate their pieces as best you can.

What happens when you manage to move a piece to the other end? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Idle Legend
description: Dive into an exciting world! Fight monsters, gather battle energy, unlock bosses, and defeat them to earn coins. Spend coins on upgrades, skins, and pets. Enjoy vibrant cartoon graphics and exciting quests. Start your adventure today!

title: Hamstercycle
description:
Help a genius hamster bust out of a mad professor's lab on his slick DIY ride - the Hamstercycle!

Jump across furniture and whatever junk the prof left lying around to reach the portal at the end of each room. But watch out - the floor is guarded by laser sensors! Touch it, and the hamster gets caught!

Fun physics, simple controls, and hundreds of exciting levels await!

title: Pirates Mahjong
description: Pirates Mahjong is a classic tile-matching game featuring challenging levels. Match pairs of pirate-themed tiles to clear the board, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden tiles along the way. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and pirate fans alike, Pirates Mahjong offers endless fun and excitement on the high seas!

title: Giant Crowd io House Capture
description: Come to lead your squad in Giant Crowd io House Capture, a fun .io strategy adventure game. You will expand your power in the city, occupy more houses and become the winner of the city. Grow your crowd by collecting more followers as you explore the city.

title: Merge cubes 2048 3D
description: A completely new approach to the classic game 2048?! Now in 3D and with dynamic physics?! Number cubes don't just merge - they bounce and collide?, adding an element of surprise to every game! Compete with friends or colleagues?!

title: Addiction Mini Solitaire
description: Mini version of Addiction Solitaire. Use empty spots to arrange all cards in color and in sequence from A to 6. You can move a card to a gap if it is the same color and 1 higher in value than the card to the left of the gap. You have 1 reshuffle. After the Ace you need to place a 2 and then ascending to 6.

title: TOP HOG
description: Welcome to the forest adventure! A drowsy bear just wants to rest, but a playful group of hedgehogs  has decided to throw a party close by. Your task? Grab a hockey stick and send those troublemakers soaring through the air! Build your strength, collect bonuses to enhance your skills, and face the exciting challenges in each level. Who will rise as the winter forest champion? Become a true bear hockey expert! Simple to play, fun, and packed with thrilling airborne action! Give it a try now!

title: Paper Wars: Battles and Upgrades
description: Real battle on a sheet of paper! Choose your troops, aim, and destroy the enemy. Play with a friend or against AI. Unlock new fighters and upgrade your attacks!

title: Nugget Man Survival Puzzle
description: Are you ready for adventure with the Nugget man character? To save the Nugget Man character who is stranded in the desert, you must fly into the sky without bursting the balloons. You must be careful to take the character to the finish by solving the puzzles before time runs out, accompanied by Gedagedago music. Rescue Nugget Man through desert bandits, cacti and many other challenging obstacles! Enjoy.

title: Traffic Light Simulator 3D
description:
"Traffic-Light simulator" is an immersive simulation game where players take on the role of a traffic controller tasked with managing the flow of vehicles through a bustling city intersection. Set against the backdrop of a dynamic urban landscape, players must strategically operate a traffic light to prevent congestion, accidents, and ensure smooth traffic flow.
With each passing level, the intensity and complexity of traffic increase, testing the player's decision-making skills and reflexes.

title: 3D Chess Master
description: 3D Chess Master – The ultimate 3D chess experience! Enjoy stunning three-dimensional graphics while testing your strategy skills. Challenge your friends in head-to-head matches or take on powerful AI opponents in the most immersive chess game yet.

title: Br Br Patapim: Obby Challenge
description: Br Br Patapim: Obby Challenge is a wild meme-fueled obby game where you’ll jump, fall, and laugh your way through chaos! Inspired by the viral spirit of Italian Brainrot Animals of TikTok trends, this game turns parkour madness into pure comedy. Take control of the legendary Brr Brr Patapim and conquer ridiculous levels full of traps, platforms, and meme-powered surprises.

title: Mahjong Connect Majong Class
description: Mahjong Connect is a classic elimination-style casual game where players need to find and connect identical mahjong tiles on the board. The game rules are simple yet challenging, suitable for players of all ages.

title: Word Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with a fresh twist on a classic with Word Solitaire! This addictive word solitaire blends clever word-building with strategic card gameplay, creating a unique solo experience. Find categories, reveal hidden words, and clear the board in increasingly challenging levels. Perfect for quick breaks or long sessions—relax, think, and master the art of words!

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Monster Vs Zombie
description: Slide the monster to help it eat all the zombies in the way. Use your strategic thinking and problem solving skill to avoid all obstacle and reach the gate to go to the next level.

title: Kings and Queens Mahjong
description: Enter the magical Royal Kingdom in Kings & Queens Mahjong! Match pairs of jewels, crowns, and other royal treasures to clear the board and climb the Royal Leaderboard. Race against the clock, use boosters like Hint, Shuffle, and Undo when needed, and enjoy handcrafted tiles with a majestic design. Perfect for puzzle lovers looking for a royal challenge!

title: Knife Madness
description: Aim, throw and survive! Watch out — avoid hitting other blades. The spinning wheel gets faster, the stakes get higher and only your quick reflexes will keep you in the game. Can you defeat the boss levels and unlock epic knife skins? The challenge is on!

title: Grow Castle Defence
description: It's a completely different castle defense game. Strengthen your soldiers and prepare them for battle. Upgrade your archers for a better defense. Fight different enemies by leveling up. Each level adds to the excitement of the game. Watch as the enemies of the pal world evolve as you face them. Earn coins for each enemy and grow stronger.

title: Draw To Crush : Monster Game
description: Play the thrilling "Draw To Crush: Monster game" . Use your artistic talent to defeat evil creatures. sketch and destroy the monster and save animals and the good clown at the same time is your task, you have to draw the line that changes into a three-dimensional weapon to blast the monster.

title: Racing Ball Adventure
description:
Race down massive slopes at high speed through stunning green plains, cliffs, and canyons!
In this thrilling arcade adventure, collect the mystical Crystal to save the world from an impending disaster.
Grab your sphere and start your journey — an epic low-poly adventure awaits!

title: Brainrots Lava Survive Online
description: Brainrots Lava Survive Online is an intense survival experience where rising lava transforms the map into a dangerous obstacle zone. Players must collect brainrots in risky areas and escape before the lava blocks safe routes. Online mode is available in 1 Player, allowing chat and interaction, while 2 Player mode offers local shared-screen competition. With more than 60 characters in normal, gold, diamond, Celestial, and time-limited Divine tiers, progression stays dynamic.

title: Bubble Shooter Aura
description:
Bubble Shooter Aura brings a fresh, glowing twist to the classic bubble-shooting experience.
Enter a world of soft colors, smooth animations, and relaxing “aura” effects as you match and pop bubbles to clear levels and reach high scores.

Perfect for both casual players and bubble shooter fans, this game offers intuitive controls, satisfying gameplay, and a modern look that feels calm, fun, and addictive.

title: The Best Warrior
description: In The Best Warrior, you start as a humble peasant with one goal—to become the greatest warrior in the kingdom. Train by clicking on dummies to build attack power, defeat enemies for gold, and unlock powerful skins to grow even faster. Face epic bosses, collect timed chest rewards, and rise through multiple levels. With nonstop action, upgrades, and progression, this free adventure clicker game lets you prove your strength with every tap. Start your journey now and become a legend!

title: Robbie: Stand on the Right Color!
description:
Welcome to the vibrant world of speed and reaction!
You are about to be tested on your attentiveness and lightning-fast decisions. Your task is simple but tricky: step on the right color before the floor disappears beneath your feet!
Suitable for anyone who loves fast, simple, and addictive games.
Are you ready to help Robbie stand his ground?

title: Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up
description: Dress up your paper doll with mystical styles in Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up! ?✨ Get ready to enter a dreamy world where fantasy meets fashion. This isn’t just a dress-up game—it’s your magical escape, where every outfit tells a story and every style reveals a spellbound secret. Whether you're a fashion dreamer, a lover of magic, or a diary keeper at heart, this enchanted adventure is made just for you.

title: Alien Chase - Swing and Fly
description: Alien Chase - Swing and Fly is the wildest swinging game in town! Play as a superhero on vacation, caught in the middle of an alien invasion. With nothing but your grappling skills, swing between towering skyscrapers and outrun the relentless alien swarm. It’s fast, it’s frantic, and it’s an endless escape—how far can you swing?

title: Gem Deep Digger
description: Dive deep into the underground world of Gem Deep Digger. In a fun and addictive simulation game,you dig, collect, and upgrade to uncover hidden treasures. With simple one-button controls, anyone can become the ultimate miner. Use your dig to carve through layers of dirt and rock, uncovering sparkling gems in the ground.

title: Blue VS Red
description: Sort blue and red items as fast as you can! Drag or use arrow keys to send each item to the correct zone. Build combos, beat the timer, and earn coins to buy power-ups. Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete against AI bots. How high can you score in 30 seconds?

title: Fusion 2048
description: Fusion 2048 is an addictive puzzle game where you combine matching numbered blocks to reach higher values and aim for the elusive 2048 block. Play in Classic or Shape Mode, plan your moves to avoid filling the container, and use TNT blocks to clear space. With clean visuals, smooth controls, and score tracking, it’s perfect for quick sessions or long strategic runs—easy to pick up, hard to master.

title: Shape-Shifting
description: Choose different vehicles to adapt to various terrains, allowing yourself to navigate through the terrain faster and become the first in the race.

title: Tap It Away 3D
description: Tap It Away 3D is a fun and relaxing 3D block puzzle game. Tap the arrows to move and clear blocks, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and plan your moves carefully as blocks can block each other. Enjoy smooth, stress-free gameplay with no time limits. Play this free online puzzle game to relax, sharpen your logic, and train your brain anytime.

title: Farmer Pedro
description:
Get ready to till the soil and reap the rewards in Farmer Pedro!

In this charming 3D farming simulator, you’ll take on the role of Pedro, a humble farmer with a big dream - to build the most bountiful farm in the countryside. Start by driving your trusty tractor around the initial plot of land, harvesting a variety of crops like corn, tomatoes, carrots, and more.

As you grow and harvest your crops, you’ll earn cash that can be used to expand your farmland and unlock access to new crops.

title: Jump In To The Plane
description: Want to feel like a super agent? Jump into a plane with your car! Race against time, perform crazy stunts, and wreak havoc in this insane game. Buckle up and put the pedal to the metal! Explore dozens of locations and vehicles. One wrong move and you're gone! Hurry, you've got a plane to catch!

title: Kingdom Wars TD
description: Welcome to Kingdom Wars TD, an exciting tower-defense strategy game set in a captivating 2D kingdom. Assume the role of a skilled commander entrusted with the defense of a mighty castle. In your quest, assemble a formidable army comprising up to five soldiers, including archers, warriors, and priests. Brace yourself for the challenge of surviving two perilous waves across various meticulously designed levels scattered throughout the map. Immerse yourself in this thrilling adventure!

title: Archer Go
description: Endless arrows, endless fun! Get ready for a thrilling endless game that will put your archery skills to the test. Travel through a fantastic landscape with your bow, aiming at targets along the way. Keep playing, earn points and unlock exciting customization options.

title: Idle Airport CEO
description:
Step into the shoes of a savvy CEO and take control of your very own airport!

As you progress, collect passengers and upgrade your capabilities to increase plane capacity, speed, and efficiency. Optimize check-in times, revenue streams, and airline services to keep your customers happy and coming back for more.

Oh, and did we mention that your money is piling up as we speak? Go offline, return and claim profits.

title: Panda Adventure
description: A small panda has to go through many challenges to reach his home safely form school. there will be many challenges on the way

title: IDLE Pet
description: Anatomical clicker. Start with one cell and create a whole animal! You will see what the body is made of from the inside, gradually growing bones, organs, skin and wool!

title: Get To The Chopper
description: Gear up and fight your way to safety in Get To The Chopper, a thrilling 3D first-person shooter where every mission is a battle for survival! Your objective is clear: reach the extraction chopper while eliminating all enemies standing in your way. Armed with a fully customizable loadout—including a primary gun, secondary weapon, grenades, and a melee weapon—you’ll face waves of enemies across dynamic battlefields such as forests, deserts, and more.

title: Disassemble the picture: Puzzle!
description:
Unlock your brain power and dive into the world of puzzles!
Start playing "Disassemble the picture: Puzzle!" right now!

In this fun and addictive game, your goal is to move the blocks to clear the screen and reveal the hidden image.
But here’s the twist — the blocks can only move in specific directions, so you’ll need to think carefully and plan your moves strategically.

title: Paris Kiss
description: Welcome to Paris Kiss, a fun and quirky puzzle game where your goal is simple — bring the characters together for a kiss

title: Unscrew Wood Puzzle
description: Unscrew Wood Puzzle: Screw Jam is an engaging puzzle game that combines logic, strategy, and dexterity in a tactile experience. Players are challenged to solve intricate puzzles involving bolts, nuts, and screws. With hundreds of unique levels, this game provides a blend of relaxation and mental stimulation, perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. The beautifully designed wooden and metallic elements create a visually appealing and satisfying gameplay experience.

title: Vega Mix: Sea Adventures
description: Vega Mix: Sea Adventures is an exciting three-in-a-row game with vivid effects and unique mechanics. Embark on an unforgettable adventure with brave heroes who find themselves on the seabed and explore a sunken ship and an ancient city. But their story does not end there — after that they will have to restore the ancient lighthouse on the island. Enjoy colorful levels, various bonuses and puzzles that will help you uncover the secrets of the depths of the sea and restore the lighthouse.

title: Nose Hospital
description: In Nose Hospital Games, The patients are counting on you in this nose surgery hospital game. Will you rise to the occasion and become the hero in plastic surgery games, they desperately need? Step into the operating theater and redefine the world of nose plastic surgery games.

title: Sniping aliens
description: Aliens skilled in disguise have quietly infiltrated Earth, and their traces may be found in every corner of the city. Find and kill them, and drive the evil aliens out of Earth!

title: Mask Evolution 3d
description: Mask Evolution 3D is a parkour game. Move the masks through digital gates to boost the value of your mask. You can also collect decorations and attendants to make your mask even more artistic. Finally, auction your masks to sell them for a high price and earn more money. Please note,be careful of obstacles such as spikes on the road, they will devalue your mask and you will fail when your mask value is 0. Get ready for an exciting journey to make your very own mask!

title: Stickman Football
description:
"Stickman Football" is an exciting 2D game where you take on the role of a stick football player and compete against an opponent. Your goal is to score using various moves and tricks.

You have the ability to teleport to the ball after a shot to improve your chances of scoring. This adds a strategic element to the game, as you must choose the right moment to use teleportation to get the ball into the goal.

title: Hole Eat Grow Attack
description:
Eat objects, and ammos, and attack other holes around. Two unique game modes, time attack and infinite modes are waiting for you. Let your hole battle begin in the arena against the other holes.

The game consists of two levels Time Attack and Infinite. There are more than 20 characters. You can play the game either in single-player mode or in 2 player mode. Pick your hole fighter and start the game. You can activate player 2 with keys. Make sure you avoid larger-hole enemies around.

title: Sunny Link
description: 'Sunny Link' is an easy and fun game where players match tiles with summer icons. The goal is to connect two identical tiles. Tiles can be linked if you can join them with three or fewer straight lines. The game has many levels to enjoy. As you play, you’ll hear sounds of the sea. It’s perfect for relaxing and having fun in the sun!

title: The Branch Runner
description: Are you good at endless running arcade games? Here is a chance for you to play a funny running arcade game with 3D pixel blocks. You need to help the character run forward by means of rotating the platform track and avoiding the obstacle blocks. There are many beautiful skins in the shop. As long as you earned enough gold coins, you could unlock and use them!

title: Winter Wonderland Mahjong
description: Escape into a cozy Winter Wonderland filled with snowflakes, penguins, and festive cheer! Relax with calming music as you match beautifully crafted tiles in this soothing Mahjong puzzle game. Unlock charming new backgrounds and unique tile designs as you progress, each adding warmth and wonder to your journey. Perfect for unwinding, celebrating the holidays, and discovering the magic of winter—one match at a time.

title: 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game
description: 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game lets you become the ultimate nail artist! Step into your very own nail salon where creativity has no limits. Design stunning acrylic nails with trendy styles, vibrant colors, and charming accessories. Satisfy your customers' unique requests, earn money, and upgrade your salon to become the best nail stylist in town!

title: Hostage Fishes
description: A malfunction occurred in the aquarium filter pipes. The fish in the aquarium are in a very difficult situation. If you do not repair all the pipes within 1 minute, you may cause them to disappear.  You should fix the pipes as soon as possible to solve the problem.

title: BFF Lovely Kawaii Outfits
description: Welcome to BFF Lovely Kawaii Outfits game. Princesses Elsa, Anna, Moana, and Jasmine are more fascinated about Kawaii Outfits. They are very eager to browse the new collection of Kawaii outfits. Start helping with each princess for their outfits and matching costumes by browsing their wardrobe. Play these cute girl games and have fun!

title: Monster Dash
description:
Sprint, Jump and Blast your way through Monster Dash, an action-packed game by the creators of Jetpack Joyride and Fruit Ninja.

Join Barry Steakfries and his iconic Machine Gun Jetpack in a world full of menacing monster mayhem, as you run and gun your way through hordes of zombies, vampires and more with the most explosive and powerful weapons you can find!

title: Zen Mini Games 2
description: Zen Mini Games 2 contains many different puzzle games. For example, let all the balls fall into the empty boxes on the screen so that the balls don't fall out. The difficulty of the game increases step by step. If you want to try different puzzle games, don't miss the Zen Mini Games 2!

title: Save little red hood
description:
Match-3 puzzles combined with physics-based gameplay: eliminate blocks to make stones fall and become Little Red Riding Hood's weapons, which she then uses to attack the wolf.
Plan your elimination route carefully, utilizing gravity to make the stones fall and become weapons—that's the ultimate goal. Various power-ups can also help you.

title: Office Pyramid Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Pyramid Solitaire is to clear the card pyramid. On hard difficulty you must also clear the draw deck.

title: Cozy Kitchen Merge
description: This is an addictive cooking-themed merge game you won't be able to put down. Here, you'll become a kitchen master by merging identical ingredients and dishes to create new, more delicious cuisine. From simple vegetables to exotic feasts, continuously unlock tasty recipes from around the world. Fulfill customer orders to earn coins, and use them to upgrade and decorate your kitchen, transforming it from a humble diner into a dream culinary paradise.

title: CANDY LOVE
description: Let's erase the same candies by matching 3 or more of them! You can take a candy from the tapped row and put it on the tapped row. The game ends when the candy reaches the bottom.

title: Ocean Small Hospital Doctor
description: Dive into the exciting world of Ocean Small Hospital - Doctor! This casual and educational game is an absolute blast for animal lovers. In this game, you'll step into the role of a heroic doctor on a submarine-turned-hospital. Your mission? Rescue injured sea animals from the vast ocean depths. As you spot a distressed creature, quickly assemble your medical team and gear.

title: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D
description: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D is an exciting and simple scooter game where you ride through challenging tracks filled with obstacles. Your main goal is to reach the finish line without crashing. As you play, you’ll need to dodge barriers, keep your balance, and react fast. You can collect coins along the way to unlock new scooters with cool designs. With smooth controls and many levels to explore, the game offers fun, speed, and tricks for anyone who loves action on two wheels.

title: Hero Tower War
description:
Many monsters and enemies in the tower. You need to defeat them, get treasures and save hostages.

You can play everywhere ,every time. It is a boring killer game.

title: Save My Pet Party
description: Cute pets need protection, would you like to help them? Draw protection walls for bees coming from different locations in each level and stop them. In levels you find difficult, you can get hints or skip the level directly. You can play Save My Pet Party game in 1 Player or 2 Player modes.

title: Chroma Tower
description: Chroma Tower is a reverse-Tetris puzzle where you destroy instead of build! You're given a tower made of colored blocks. Drop blocks from above, match the color — and the entire connected chain disappears. Blocks fall to fill the gaps, potentially triggering new cascade reactions. Your goal is to demolish the tower completely within a limited number of moves.

title: Katana
description:
It's a first-person Katana game!
Slice all the enemy ninjas into small pieces and save the hostages. Use multiple katana swords and shurikens. Fight epic bosses and complete the levels.

title: Cartoon Moto Stunt
description: "Cartoon Moto Stunt is a gripping racing and customization game with 24 thrilling levels! Choose from 4 unique motorcycles, each with 4 eye-catching designs. Use coins earned to buy and upgrade bikes. Each level presents new challenges, requiring lightning-fast reflexes and precise timing. With vibrant cartoon graphics and addictive gameplay, it's perfect for adrenaline junkies and racing enthusiasts. Prepare for daring stunts and race to victory!"

title: Chinese Food Chef DuDu
description: Are you a fan of Chinese food? Do you want to discover the mystery of delicious Chinese cuisine? You do not want to miss this cooking game - Chinese Food Chef DuDu. Here, you have the chance to learn different recipes of traditional Chinese food, such as dumplings, rice dumplings, and zongzi. Win the heart of the little monkey with your delicious Chinese food!

title: Among Squid Challenge Online
description: All players, get ready. They are hiding in a maze. To win the game, you must defeat all the other players. You have a knife and must defeat everyone. Catch the players one by one and make sure they are eliminated. Don’t worry, they won’t find you. If they try to find you, hide in the ventilation holes. Defeat all the players. Be careful, and whatever you do, don't reveal yourself. If they catch you, you will lose and they will defeat you.

title: Nuts & Bolts Puzzle
description:
Play Nuts and Bolts Game, the new brain-challenging puzzle to challenge and test your IQ. Train your mind while relaxing with multiple levels of our game.
Become the master of logic puzzles and enjoy the creative gameplay we have prepared especially for you.

title: Obby Rainbow Tower
description: Obby Rainbow Tower is a fast, winter-themed tower race where every second and every jump matters. Each floor is packed with moving platforms, icy tiles, spinning lava bars, surprise snowstorms and snowball portals that try to knock you into the void.  You can replay the tower as many times as you like, trying to beat your own best time or racing a friend side by side in 2 player mode.

title: Little Bugs
description: you are the guardian of a group of lost beetles. At each stage, the beetles approach two pictures. One is a safe path forward, but the other is a trapdoor into the abyss. Your mission is to decipher the hint—a piece of a vegetable or an animal—to figure out which path is safe. If you misunderstand the clue, you won't be able to reach the finish line. Every choice matters in this charming world of clever puzzles. Are you ready to lead your little bugs to safety?

title: Pool 8
description: Pool 8 is a relaxing yet challenging billiards-style puzzle game where players must sink all the balls into the pockets in the correct order. The game follows a step-by-step movement system, requiring strategic planning to clear the table efficiently. With smooth mechanics and progressively difficult levels, Pool 8 offers a unique twist on classic pool gameplay, perfect for puzzle and strategy lovers.

title: Get a cool gun!
description:
The dynamic gun runner game gives a shooting experience with the creation and evolution of weapons. Combine parts to get new weapon modules.

It is a fun and casual puzzle. In the game, the game screen is fresh and simple, and the cute cartoon style is very eye-catching. The biggest highlight is the addition of tower defense battles to the brick-moving gameplay. The game level is very rich, and the gameplay is very simple. 
You can control the movement of the character by pressing and sliding on the screen.
What the player has to do is to control the character to collect the bricks on the map, stack the bricks and send them to your base. When there are enough bricks, your base will be upgraded and the area will be expanded and the number of tower defenses will be increased. 
When the enemy enters the range of your tower defense, you will be attacked. 
On the contrary, when you enter the range of the enemy tower defense, you will also be attacked. whichever side is attacked and dies first will fail the game, otherwise it will succeed.
Players who like brick-moving games come and download it.

title: Hunting underwater spearfishing
description:
Hunting underwater spearfishing – a realistic diving adventure!

Dive into underwater exploration as a diver in a wetsuit, hunting with scuba gear. Explore lakes, seas, and oceans, encounter 30+ marine species, and marvel at coral reefs. Freediving, underwater hunting, and treasure searches await! Upgrade harpoons, masks, and tanks, battle predators, and survive hostile depths. Discover new locations and earn rewards to improve with every dive!

title: Tanks Merge: Tank War Blitz
description:
Embark on an armored adventure in Tanks Merge: Tanks to Attack on the Blitz! -
a strategy game where steel giants dominate the world.
Immerse yourself in a casual yet addictive tank simulation game
designed for those who love war machines and inventive tactics.
Have a blitz rumble and defeat all the bosses!
Your mission: control a fleet of tanks, each unique in design and
to defeat enemies and all bosses on the battlefield.

title: Onet Monster Book
description:
A "match-the-pairs" genre game where you need to find matching images and connect them. But it's not that simple: there are tons of pictures, and you have to find the right ones.

Match all the books with the same little monsters on the covers — once you've paired them all, the level is complete! With over 100 levels, meditative gameplay, various cute monsters, and beautiful graphics. Play and relax!

title: Counter Craft Sniper
description: Counter Craft Sniper is a first-person shooter where you step into the boots of an elite sniper sent to protect a city invaded by Minecraft mobs. Creepers, skeletons, and zombies have appeared in the middle of downtown, and only your precision and quick reflexes can stop them before the chaos spreads. Armed with your trusty sniper rifle, you must take position on rooftops and high vantage points to eliminate every hostile target that threatens the civilians below.

title: Dead Zone Mech Ops
description:
Dead Zone: Mech Ops thrusts players into the heart of a scorched Earth ravaged by endless war, where autonomous factions and rogue AI compete for control over the planet’s last remaining strongholds. You are a combat pilot in the elite “Mech Ops” unit — the final line of defense in a world on the brink of total collapse.
Players will command next-gen combat exosuits equipped with modular weapon systems, advanced targeting tech, and adaptive armor that reacts to battlefield conditions.

title: Bubbly Lab
description: Bubbly Lab is a physics puzzle game where you have to catch all the adorable bubbles in the laboratory. Use a super strong vacuum cleaner to get the bubbles into the flask. Use your logic to move lab items to help you get bubbles. Solve interesting puzzles in this fun and unique game!

title: Angry City Smasher
description: Angry City Smasher is a third-person RPG fighting simulation game with 3D-armed gorillas. Your goal is to defeat the enemy monster and destroy the marked number of buildings. Use the Ultimate Smash to make AOE damage and destroy more buildings with one hit. To be honest, it is necessary to defeat your opponent first because it will run to you on the level. No one wants to be disturbed by others. Good luck!

title: Park Me: Draw Path
description: "Park Me: Draw Path" is a casual puzzle game integrating "painting + parking + puzzle solving", which adds "drawing lines" to the traditional parking gameplay, testing the player's logical thinking, spatial imagination and path planning ability, and getting an "intellectual exercise" in a short period of time.

title: Drop Bricks Breaker
description: Drop Bricks Breaker is an interesting casual puzzle game. You can relax yourself during play time. You only need to tap the screen to aim the bricks, then launch the ball. Isn't easy it? Come to try it now! Have a great time!

title: Mushroom blocks
description: Meet colorful and diverse mushrooms! Collect mushroom blocks, earn points and win the rankings! On the way you will encounter all kinds of obstacles: lightning, bombs, frozen cells and others. Try to overcome all obstacles and hold out as long as possible, plunging into the cozy atmosphere of mushroom picking, accompanied by pleasant music!

title: Craft Block World Building
description: Welcome to Craft Block World Building! This is the creative simulator to ignite your creativity. In this colorful world of cubes, you can build, design and create your own amazing world! You can also drive a car and explore the open landscape! Feel the thrill of driving across blocky mountains, rivers, and endless fields!

title: Wipe Insight Master
description: Dop 3: Draw One Part is a free drawing online game for boys. Use your finger to draw and outline the shapes of the parts that the drawings need. Solve puzzles by using your powers of logic and lateral thinking as you work your way through a huge series of cute drawings that all have something a little bit wrong with them, it's up to you to work it out!

title: Two Blocks
description: Two Blocks - is a user-friendly game—connect two or more blocks of the same color to clear them from the board.Two Blocks features 80 levels, gradually increasing in difficulty with varying objectives. Ready to challenge your intelligence and strategic thinking?

title: Cyber Monday
description: Cyberpunk Monday thrusts you into a neon-drenched arcade cyberpunk adventure. Hack terminals, dodge digital foes, and race across futuristic CityGrid zones. Look for combos, outsmart AI, and collect cyber credits in this fast-paced hacking runner. Perfect for fans of cyberpunk games, arcade game thrills, free mobile games, and even cool math games that students love. Gear up—your Monday just got cyber.

title: Dop Puzzle Erase Master
description:
It is an interesting online game that will take you to an unparalleled puzzle-solving  experience. To solve the puzzles, you may use your imagination and ingenuity. You need to consider what do I erase to pass the level. Within the challenging levels, you  need to use strategic thinking to conquer each puzzle. In each level, you must make use of the
  eraser to erase a part of the picture to show a hidden object or scene. The deletion puzzles are  easy to learn, but challenging to master.

title: Sprunki Shooter 2025
description: Sprunki Shooter 2025 is a free to play online game that delivers exciting shooting action in a colorful and challenging world. Players must navigate through each level, clearing obstacles and defeating enemies to reach the exit. The goal is to complete all levels by unlocking the exit doors. To do this, players must shoot and collect all the scattered diamonds while avoiding or eliminating dangerous enemies along the way. Have fun!

title: Sky Balls 3D
description: Sky Balls 3D invites you on an adventure as you travel through the sky with rolling balls and test your reaction skills. Keep the ball on the track without letting it fall and watch out for obstacles, traps and gaps! Collect coins and keys along the way to get new ball skins and sky-boxes. You can play the game in 1 player and 2 player modes.

title: Crazy 2248 Link - Matching Puzzle Game
description: 2248 is a classic number merge link matching puzzle game. The player's challenge goal is to merge the number blocks into 1024, 2048, 4096, and finally reach the infinity block!

title: Lingo Dreams
description:
Learn English while playing
Lingo Dreams is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that helps you memorize English words through matching exercises. Find the correct pairs between your native language and English to complete each level.

Perfect for beginners, kids, or anyone who wants to expand their vocabulary while having fun.

title: Only Up
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey from ground zero to the skies in Only Up! However, there's a twist – there are no checkpoints on this ascent. Stumble, and you must swiftly catch yourself to avoid losing precious progress. Will you conquer the summit, or succumb to the challenge and give up?

title: Sudoku Brain Blocks
description: Sudoku Brain Blocks is a relaxing yet addictive online puzzle game that blends classic Sudoku logic with block-fitting challenges (Tetris style). Drag and drop various shaped blocks onto a 9×9 grid to complete full rows, columns, or 3×3 squares to clear the board and earn high scores. Use strategy and planning to avoid running out of space and test your brain with every move!

title: Math Runner
description: Challenge your mind and reflexes in this fast-paced arithmetic adventure! Solve math problems on the run, dodge obstacles, and race against time to achieve the highest score. Perfect for players of all ages looking to sharpen their math skills while enjoying thrilling gameplay.

title: Hair Stack 3D
description: Hair Stack 3D is a hair running game. Go through the numbered doors and collect more hair. Dodge the obstacles that make you less in number. Your ultimate goal is to make more hair so that the bald head at the end can have beautiful hair! Are you ready to help him? Let him applaud you!

title: Stickman Brawler
description: Embark on an epic stickman conquest in Stickman Brawler, where you navigate a relentless battlefield, pitted against hordes of stickman adversaries. Harness your combat skills by selecting up to three powerful abilities, such as devastating swipe kicks, golem summoning, and colossal transformations. Unlock achievements, gather town resources to acquire potent power-ups from the godfather, and collect cards for exciting new skins, as you strive to become the ultimate stickman brawler.

title: SHOT CAN WILD
description: Keep tapping to shoot and prevent the can from falling! The game ends when you run out of ammo. Hit the center of te target for a COOL SHOT! Chain COOL SHOT to restore ammo!

title: Block Craft 3d
description: Block Craft 3D is a first-person RPG game with 3D pixel Minecraft models. Starting from a block base, you can attack the monsters outside to claim diamonds with weapons. I strongly suggest you build bombs to destroy terrains or build blocks to make yourself safe. When you earn enough diamonds, you can unlock and use 4 Melee weapons, 11 guns, and 8 bombs in the store. Glad you will have a good time in this block world.

title: Resident Evil: Purge Operation
description: At the start of each level, players must quickly locate powerful weapons like the shotgun and sniper rifle, crucial for fending off hordes of zombies. Once the eerie alarm sounds, grotesque, ferocious undead flood the area. A single mistake can lead to being swarmed, so precise marksmanship, agile movement, and calm judgment are essential for survival.​

title: Maze Escape : Craft Man
description:
Objective:
Navigate through a series of craft doors and escape the maze without being killed by terrifying entities.

Gameplay:

    Explore the Maze: Move through a maze filled with multiple doors, each leading to new and more challenging areas.
    Survive the Entities: Avoid or outsmart various entities that lurk in the maze, each with unique behaviors and attack patterns.
    Find the Next Door: Continuously search for the next door to progress to subsequent levels of the maze.
    Collect Items: Gather keys to unlock doors, coins for upgrades, and useful tools to aid in your survival.

title: Draw to Fish Fight
description: Are you ready? It's time to smack some fish with Skibidi! This fun and crazy game lets you dive into Skibidi's exciting adventure and discover his fish-smacking skills. Smack the fish that come your way and collect points. Avoid obstacles and collect bonuses to power up Skibidi. The more fish you smack, the higher your score! Share your high scores with friends and compete with them.

title: Merge Car Defense
description:
Prepare to battle wave upon wave of relentless enemies as you skilfully merge and upgrade the defences of your cars.

Build out a roster of cars and use them tactically in order to defeat the enemy, collect coins and be victorious!

title: Music Cat! Piano Tiles Game 3D
description: Discover a wonderful world of music and fun with this new free online game! Looking for a cute cat game? Do you want to feel the rhythm of the music in your every move on the tiles? Then this dance runner with cute dancing cats is exactly what you need!

title: Black Hole: Beauty Makeup
description: Black Hole: Beauty Makeup is a game where the player controls a black hole trying to devour as many objects around it as possible. Eat more, grow more, then create a beauty makeover!  Cool black hole simulator. Absorb different objects. Unlock skins. Do you like black hole and simulators?

title: Bowmasters
description: Bowmasters is a fun and action-packed game that combines creative physics with exciting Archery gameplay. Use different types of bows and weapons. Draw your weapon, judge the angle, and fire arrows to hit all enemies. The game shines with its physics-based mechanics, where timing, distance, and trajectory matter. You’ll need real skill and smart thinking to solve each shooting puzzle and land accurate hits. Every match feels different thanks to unique characters and varied weapons.

title: BouncePop Quest
description: Guide Jumpo, a squishy and color-changing jelly creature, through over 150 vibrant levels filled with tricky obstacles, moving platforms, and environmental hazards. Charge and release powerful jumps to collect stars, dodge enemies, and unlock new worlds—from the icy peaks to fiery lava lands. Master timing, aim for achievements, and power up in this cute, bouncy adventure!

title: Guess Word
description: Guess Word is a free online puzzle and word game for boys played on PuzzleGame. It's easy to play. You have six chances to guess words. The letter you guessed will change color to give you a hint. This tests your vocabulary. The game is simple and very suitable for players of all ages. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable! We have three modes for you. Challenge yourself!

title: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets is an exciting hidden object game where magic and time intertwine in a thrilling adventure. Everything changed when a mysterious magical crystal activated, scattering objects across time! You'll enter a world of riddles, hidden objects, and temporal paradoxes.

title: Snap Fix
description:
Snap Fix is a fast-paced block puzzle game where you slide tiles to restore a scrambled picture.
With one empty space to maneuver, you must think quickly and arrange the grid before time runs out!
Complete the puzzle to unlock and download the image as a reward.
Can you snap everything into place before the clock hits zero?

title: Enchanted Mahjong Saga
description: Enchanted Mahjong Saga is a fast-paced twist on the classic tile-matching game, with unlimited levels to challenge your mind. Match tiles, beat the clock, and keep your streak alive as each level gets tougher and more exciting. Feeling stuck? Use helpful hints to get back on track and stay in the game.Whether youre playing for a quick break or settling in for a longer session, theres always a new puzzle waiting.

title: Makeup Trends: Then And Now
description: Step into the exciting world of makeup transformations with  Makeup Trends: Then And Now! Join influencer Kiki as you explore the evolution of beauty trends from the early 2000s to 2024. Experiment with y2k-VSCO and emo-euphoria dark looks, mixing vibrant eyeshadows, bold lip colors, and edgy styles. Customize unique hairstyles and accessories to complete your makeup looks. With endless possibilities to mix and match, become a beauty trendsetter in this fun and engaging game for girls.

title: Jelly-Belly. Make the Elephant
description: It is a puzzle like "Watermelon game" where you need drop animals in a container and try not to cross the top line. Animals of the same type will combine and create a larger animal. Merge the animals to create the biggest animal - Elephant.

title: Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle
description:
Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle! is a relaxing and brain-teasing puzzle game where you must spot, drag, and fix the misplaced parts of beautiful images.
Each level challenges you to find hidden pieces, pull them out, and place them exactly where they belong.
With handcrafted levels, soothing music, and satisfying visuals, it's the perfect game to relax and train your observation skills.
Can you restore every picture to perfection?

title: Phrasle Master
description: Guess words of wisdom, proverbs and sayings in a fun brainteaser. Tap the words to make a phrase, and try to solve a riddle in 5 attempts using the color hints. As you progress, hidden phrases get longer, so you will need to apply all your logic and puzzle-solving skills to cope with the solve the riddles. Besides, such word games let you expand your vocabulary and learn foreign languages in a fun way. So, prove your skill as you decipher witty quotes and proverbs in a free word game online.

title: Sudoku Garden
description: Players must expand their thinking to solve puzzles in adventures. Learn to approach problems from different angles and discover hidden clues and patterns to overcome challenges. These games test wit while fueling interest and challenge-seeking mentality.

title: Frogga
description: Guide Frogga across a busy road in this exciting frogger-style game. Tap to make Frogga jump forward, timing your movements carefully to avoid the oncoming traffic. Each level presents new challenges with faster cars and trickier obstacles, keeping you on your toes. Collect bonuses and power-ups along the way to help Frogga on his journey.

title: Mermaid Wedding World
description: Mermaid Wedding World is a creative dress-up and decorating game for girls. The princess of the ocean kingdom is getting married to a human and they are going to have a wedding now. You can help prepare the food, set the table, serve the people, and play music. You may help the bride, groom,and other guests to dress up and makeup. You may also decorate the room to your liking.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
description: Strawberry Shortcake has big dreams. She wants to be the BEST baker that Big Apple City  has ever seen and that's why she packed her bags and went to live with her Aunt Praline to the only place where a baker can go if they want to become the best in the whole world: the BIG APPLE CITY!

title: Sprunki Memory Card Match
description:
Put your memory to the ultimate test with Sprunki Memory Card Match! Dive into a world of fun and challenge as you flip cards to reveal and match delightful Sprunki characters, scenes, and surprises. Perfect for kids and adults alike, this game combines entertainment with brain-boosting fun!
Challenge yourself or compete with friends to see who has the sharpest memory. With Sprunki Memory Card Match, every flip is a step closer to unlocking fun surprises and reaching the top!

title: The Noob Aventures
description:
The Noob Adventures invites you to join a dangerous journey through a colorful world full of action, traps, and enemies. Travel across challenging lands in search of diamonds and overcome all obstacles. Complete 70 levels packed with danger and surprises as you fight enemies determined to stop your progress. Rescue the friends, survive the challenges along the way, and prove that even a noob can become a true hero.
Collect diamonds and unlock new characters to continue your adventure

title: Vibe Colouring
description: Relax with your favorite color by number game! Paint hundreds of pictures — from funny memes to calm landscapes. Every drawing is a little story that comes to life with your colors. Over 100 levels already in the game, and the library keeps growing. All pictures are open and free — no limits or waiting. Hints will show you where uncolored areas are hiding. Check the leaderboard to see who colored the most areas.

title: Merge Sesame
description: This is a game anyone can easily learn and enjoy with the whole family!  With addictive sound effects and feedback, complete consecutive combos to relieve stress! If you hit a high combo with an object, your score will soar! There are no penalties or time limits, which means you can enjoy the game at your own pace. If you are looking for wonderful combination effects that are pleasing to the eye, join this game and challenge for the best score.

title: Merge Brainrot 2
description:
Drop and merge the new  Italian Brainrot memes!
From "Bobrito Bandito" to "Špijuniro Golubiro" and "Burbaloni Lulilolli", they’re all here.
What final Brainrot will you unlock? Dare to find out!

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

title: Town Run
description: Town Run is an excellent option if you enjoy games that require you to run continuously. It combines action-packed gameplay, vibrant graphics, and infinite running! Catching the raccoon is the goal. You'll need to sprint, leap, avoid obstacles, gather cash, and more in order to accomplish that!

title: Cowboys Duel
description: In this fast-paced cowboy showdown, players can either compete solo or engage in a thrilling duel against a friend, testing their reflexes and quick draw skills. Will you answer the call to become the fastest and most skilled cowboy around?

title: Cat Life Merge Money
description: Experience the life of a stray cat, beg from humans, earn money to buy food, and merge the money you beg to get more money. Only by acting quickly can you enter the rich cat life! First of all,all you need to do is click on the cat and let it beg all the time. Otherwise, it will be lazy.

title: Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll
description: Unleash chaos in Stick Boy: Bazooka War! Blast through levels with a variety of powerful bazookas, each with unique abilities. Obliterate enemies, destroy bases, and demolish everything in your path. Choose the perfect ammo to send ragdoll foes flying and experience thrilling destruction as you crush their strongholds. Help Stick Boy annihilate all adversaries and conquer every level in this explosive adventure!

title: Physics Balls
description: Physics Balls is a creative and challenging math and physics puzzle game. Here has numbers and ball elements. Improve your logical thinking and hands-on skills while having fun. Your aim is to break all bricks in one shoot. Throw balls to make them roll among the bricks. You can apply physical principles to control the balls cleverly.

title: Dino Hunter King
description: Action-packed FPS games have long attracted players. Enjoy dinosaur hunting in Dino Hunter King. Enter a wild prehistoric world, become an elite hunter tracking powerful dinosaurs across open grasslands.

title: Paws & Pals Diner
description:
Welcome to Paws & Pals Diner!

Step into the paws of a diner manager and embark on a delightful 2D adventure where every customer and staff member is an adorable animal! In this charming and whimsical world, you'll manage a bustling diner filled with furry friends, unlock delicious foods, and attract a variety of cute customers.

Are you ready to create the diner of your dreams and make every animal's visit a memorable one?

Join Paws & Pals Diner today!

title: Colored Bricks
description: Colored Bricks is a fun and simple endless game. There are colorful bricks and one on the top. You should move that one to the right or left. When it hits the same color brick, it will destroy all bricks of the row. The challenge is to improve your high score in the limited time that you have! Some bricks have extra time if you destroy them.

title: Cube Drop Puzzle
description:
Colorful bears are waiting to splash water!

Welcome to Cube Drop Puzzle!

Are you ready to start puzzle solving? Play Cube Drop Puzzle now and make a splash!

title: Container Sort Puzzle
description:
Container Sort Puzzle - Sort All the Cargo!
Get ready to test your brain with Container Sort Puzzle, the ultimate cargo-sorting challenge! Load the right containers onto the right ships and become a port master!
Perfect for fans of sort games, stacking puzzles, and logic-based challenges. Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned puzzler, Container Sort Puzzle will keep your brain sharp and entertained.

title: Hyper Knight
description:
The apocalypse began and ancient creatures emerged from their graves. You are people's only hope. Put on your armor and start fighting.

-Collect the souls of monsters and earn money.
-Find new weapons and armors.
-Discover your magical powers.
-Find a companion and it will accompany you.
-Save different towns, encounter unlimited enemies.
-Destroy the bosses that threaten the world.

Why are you waiting? Come on, grab your sword and join us.

title: Ball Sort
description: Ball Sort is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you sort colorful balls into tubes – can you solve the puzzle with fewer moves?

title: Stickman Team Detroit
description:
It's team time now! Cartoon character The game of Team Detroit is fun to watch. A gang of robbers is threatening the city of Detroit, but three little stick figures will come together to stop them.

Take pleasure in killing off enemy stickmen while using any of the three playable characters. Because of their unique abilities and weaponry, each playable character is tailor-made for their specific role.

title: Smash The Bottle
description: Bottle Smash Arcade is a fun, casual arcade smash game where you shatter bottles in wild combos—perfect for fans of cool math games and Roblox-style thrills. Master quick reflexes like in Minecraft challenge levels, or go old-school with snake game breaks. Upgrade bottle-breaking action, smash for points, crush boredom Kahoot-style in this playful, fast-paced smash-the-bottle adventure!

title: Accurate 2D
Cleaning Princess
description: This is an ASMR game for girls. If you like to clean everything, our game is right for you. The game has 5 modes: ear cleaning, heel cleaning, back spa, teeth cleaning, and fan cleaning. You can use different tools to clean and massage your body parts. But it is important to note that each mode has a countdown time and you must choose the right tool to do the cleaning.

title: Cube Connect
description: Move the blocks and guide the ball to the goal. After a period of time, the ball starts to move. Connect the paths quickly so that the ball doesn't fall. Some blocks can jump and some can warp.

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker is your ultimate creative escape into the world of anime character design. Craft stunning anime couples with romantic flair, dress up stylish girl avatars, and mix and match accessories, hairstyles, and outfits. With relaxing ASMR touches and a vibrant anime art style, this avatar creator lets your imagination shine in every love-filled duo you design.

title: Qube 2048
description: We present a unique arcade game that combines the dynamic gameplay of Q*bert and the mechanics of 2048!  You start with the number 2 and move across a grid of blocks, doubling its value. The goal is to reach the maximum number by planning your moves and avoiding obstacles.

title: Sportsball Merge
description:
Stretch, pull, and jump! Lets workout and be active in Sports Merge.

Drop the orbs filled with energy to discover new and exciting forms of exercise. Merge them all but be careful how high you jump!

What is the highest score you can reach? Come play now and lets find out!

title: Backflip Master
description: Backflip Master is the most popular in sports' game. The main test of the player's mastery of backflips and skills. You need to backflip to reach the finished line. Of course, there will be some obstacles on the way, you must also flip over. So, are you ready to challenge this game now? Come on!

title: Cosmic Aviator
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey through the depths of the cosmos in Cosmic Aviator! In this pulse-pounding arcade-style game, you find yourself piloting a sleek aircraft that's trapped within a twisting and treacherous tunnel of unknown origin. Your mission? Navigate through the endless labyrinth of obstacles and hazards while collecting valuable power-ups to boost your score to new heights.

title: Noob: Jailbreak 2
The Hardest Puzzle Ever
description:
An Exciting Puzzle Game for the Whole Family! ?

Play together and train your brain every day! ?? Enjoy thrilling puzzles suitable even for the youngest players. With new levels added daily, there's always a fresh challenge waiting for you!

Have fun, improve your skills, and become a true puzzle master! ??

title: Dino Slide
description: A puzle slide game wher you have to feed Dino. Move Dino with the keyboard arrow or swipe. Each level you have to complete the goal that consist in eating fruits and vegetables.

title: Color Sort Mania
description: Forget about everyday life and indulge in a simple world where sorting is an art. Put the bubbles in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.

title: Dark Academia Wedding
description: Step into a world of moody elegance in Dark Academia Wedding! Help the bride and groom prepare for their enchanting, gothic-inspired celebration. Choose vintage dresses, romantic accessories, and rich color palettes that capture the essence of dark academia. From candlelit ceremonies to mysterious venues, every detail matters. Create the perfect blend of classic romance and intellectual charm in this stylish wedding dress up game!

title: Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic
description:
Rediscover the captivating world of Solitaire Klondike!

This timeless card game not only entertains but also enhances logical thinking, offering hours of engaging pastime. Play your favorite solitaire anytime, anywhere.

Join the community of enthusiasts and prove your mastery in Klondike!

Keep an eye on the leaderboard and become the top player among all!

title: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
description: "Hyper Cars Ramp Crash" is a 3D stunt and crash simulation game with realistic physics and graphics. You can perform incredible stunts in many different modes with great looking cars. 7 different super-sport car models are waiting in the garage for you to try them. Open world, stunt modes and fall mode can be played in 1-player and 2-player modes.

title: Zombie Drift 3D
description: Zombie Drift 3D is a popular driving game. It doesn't require you to race or race against others, but it also tests your driving skills. You need to control the car to hit everything to make the exit open. Only in this way, you can get the success! Come on!

title: School Escape: Obbie Run!
description:
Run Obbie! The teacher will catch up with you and take you straight to the principal! 
You will play as a schoolboy Obbie. After a conflict with the teacher, you need to escape from school. 
The teacher will try to catch up with you at school, you can't let this happen. 
Collect all the keys and escape from school.

title: Coloring by Numbers. Pixel Rooms
description: Immerse yourself in a game where the process of coloring becomes truly meditative. Create and decorate houses as a designer. Just touch the screen and the colors will match the numbers in the image. Forget about boring routine - now you are thinking about color combinations. For even more relaxation, a music player has been added.

title: Merge Gun Fps Shooting Zombie
description: Merge Gun: FPS Shooting Zombie's main mission is to shoot down all coming undead creatures before they kill you. Before you join the battle, you can buy more guns and merge the same guns into new advanced ones. With more powerful and fast ammo in the clip, you can deal with incoming enemies more easily. Both zombies and crows will move forward to you even if you are still reloading. Keep calm and shoot the explosive oil cans on the ground if necessary.

title: Fireside Solitaire
description:
Fireside Solitaire is a cozy card puzzle that combines logic and relaxation by the warmth of a crackling fire.
Place cards in sequence — one rank higher or lower than the current open card — to clear all columns.
Think ahead: once the draw pile runs out, it can’t be reshuffled, and the game ends.
Enjoy calm music, soft light, and the comforting atmosphere of a winter evening by the fireplace.

title: Solitaires Crime Stories
description:
Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting new Solitaire game which will carry you away into a world of fascinating criminal investigations, colorful characters and stunning locations. Test your skills by completing interesting levels and unraveling the   mysteries of the town of Springdale!
    Springdale is a small American town that lives in peace and quiet... but that’s only at first glance. Everyone hides secrets here, secrets that could tear this carefree town apart.

title: DON'T PANIC DUDE!
description:
Meet DUDE, a sassy AI who thinks you can't beat his game! Trapped in his chaotic simulation, your goal is simple: Jump, avoid deadly spikes, and survive to prove him wrong.

Features:

Fast-paced endless jumping action.

Unlock 40 unique and funny heroes.

Hilarious AI commentary and memes.

Increasing speed and difficulty.

Can you handle the chaos? Don't panic, just jump!

title: Celebrity Wednesday Addams Style
description: Indulge in the iconic and bewitching Celebrity Wednesday Addams Style! Embrace the darkly chic aesthetics, explore mesmerizing outfits, and channel your inner gothic elegance. Discover how celebrities rock the macabre charm of Wednesday Addams with a modern twist. Unleash your inner darkness and redefine elegance with a touch of the mysterious.

title: FreeCell
description: Unlike other card games that rely on luck, almost every game of FreeCell is solvable—if you have the skill. Use the four open "free cells" as temporary holders to juggle your cards and organize the chaotic tableau. Plan your moves carefully, stack cards by alternating colors, and clear the board. Whether you want a relaxing break or a serious brain workout, this is the perfect puzzle for you.

title: Art Master Origins
description:
ART MASTERS: ORIGINS - COLORING BOOK is a educational painting game. It is a combination of color by numbers mechanics, with polish artists artworks to discover and the epic atmosphere of RPG games.

• Distinguish a falsificate from a real work!

title: Super Star Animal Salon
description: Welcome to Super Star - Animal Salon, a paws - itively delightful casual simulator game that's perfect for girls with a passion for fashion and animals! In this game, you step into the role of a superstar animal stylist. Your very own salon awaits, filled with all the tools of the trade. First, meet your furry, feathery, or scaly clients. There are cute puppies with a zebra, an elephant, and a leopard. Start with the hair.

title: Candy Maker: Dessert Games
description: Do you like match-3 games, candies, and delicious cakes? Solve sweet riddles, move puzzles, and collect culinary masterpieces! Train your brain by solving exciting puzzles! Rich graphics and pleasant music will help you relax to your advantage!

title: Lemonade Tycoon Idle
description: Tap your way from a humble lemonade stand to a global empire! Serve customers, unlock upgrades, hire staff, and expand across the world. With a dynamic day/night cycle and relaxing lo-fi music, this is the ultimate idle lemonade experience.

title: Idle Dice 3D: Incremental Game
description:
In this game, you roll dice and accumulate coins. Upgrade dice to generate more coins, even when you are not actively playing (Offline earnings).

Idle Dice 3D stands out with its variety of dice: from classic six-sided to dice with 2, 4, 8, 10, 12, and 20 sides. Aim for combinations like pairs, triples, straights, and more to increase profit.

The Prestige system allows you to reset your progress to boost future earnings, adding a strategic element to the game. The game also has achievements.

title: God's Mixer
description: Gods Mixer is a fun and experimental game where you combine different heads, bodies, and weapons to create unique characters. After assembling them, you can pit them against each other in battles to see which creation reigns supreme. The game encourages creativity through mixing and matching parts for unexpected results.

title: Eat Donuts
description: Swap, rotate, and smash colorful donut rings in a vibrant 3x3 grid to create explosive matches and devour points like never before. Start with easy levels like our sunny beachside challenge—rack up scores to hit that juicy target of 800, earn shiny coins for power-ups like the mighty hammer smash or speedy rotates, and unlock endless waves of mouthwatering fun.

title: Xeno Defense Protocol
description: Xeno Online combines high-octane top-down shooting with strategic tower defense and deep RPG progression. Your mission is simple: Establish a base, defend it against endless waves of insectoid horrors, and extract with your life.

title: Shine Seek
description: Dive into Gem Hunt Adventure, a fun treasure hunt puzzle game where you shine, seek, and solve! Explore glowing worlds, collect gems, and unlock hidden treasures while testing your brain with logic challenges. Perfect for US students searching “hidden object games,” “find the difference,” or “treasure hunt game.” With starry puzzles, bright visuals, and endless fun, this addictive casual game is the ultimate light-seeking adventure!

title: Obby Draw to Escape
description:
Have a blast in Obby illustrating your way to victory! Play the fun and relaxing casual game Draw to Escape and see if you can overcome the levels' issues using just your creativity.

You may earn money as you go through the levels, and you can earn even more coins when you reach the end of each level for every star you find. Things may vanish or explode and kill you, so be sure to check every level thoroughly.

title: Black Pink St.Patricks day Concert
description: Step into the glamorous world of Black Pink St. Patrick’s Day Concert, the ultimate dress-up game! Style your favorite Black Pink members with trendy outfits, accessories, and makeup to make them shine for their St. Patrick’s Day performance. With simple controls and endless creativity, this game is perfect for quick fun or long gaming sessions.

title: Crowd Battle Gun Rush
description: Crowd Battle Gun Rush is a weapon evolution history parkour game. At the beginning of the game, you only have an ax, which is the least lethal weapon. You must keep moving forward. On the way forward, you must collect bundles of money. , which can be used to purchase weapons and ammunition. When you prepare your weapons, you can target the groups that remain and continue to attack and eliminate them.

title: My Cake Shop: Bake & Serve
description: Run your own sweet bakery in My Cake Shop! Bake and stack colorful donuts, clean messy floors, and serve hungry customers. Expand across the world by unlocking new bakery locations and upgrading machines. Manage crowds, grow your patisserie empire, and become the ultimate idle arcade tycoon!

title: FrontWars.io
description: FrontWars.io is a multiplayer .io battle game where players battle it out to dominate as much of the globe as possible. You begin small and slowly work your way to conquer the world.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Car Racing 3D Drive Mad
description: Here is a car racing arcade game. You have a chance to control a car equiped with nitro system. You can collect the fuel to charge it. Try to defeat other AI players by avoiding obstacles and using nitro items. Have a good time!

title: Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts
description: Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts is a classic puzzle logic game where your goal is to unscrew bolts from various shapes and sort them by color into the correct containers. Each level presents a new challenge that requires patience, logic, and careful planning to succeed.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Dragon Hunter
description:
Choose your character, roll the dice and go on a fun adventure.
Click on monsters - help the hero survive and defeat the legendary dragons in the clicker RPG Dragon Hunter.
Luck and a strong phone glass will determine the fate of the dragon hunter.

title: Color Tap: Coloring by Numbers
description: Color Tap: Coloring by Numbers is a relaxation game for a serene world of creativity. Immerse yourself in the soothing art of coloring, one piece at a time, as you destress with each gentle tap.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Bonnie Fitness Frenzy
description: Bonnie decides to get her figure in perfect shape for the summer season. Join the girl in her adventures in the gym, where you will perform a variety of exercises to help her burn off extra calories. After intensive training, Bonnie will start applying makeup. And finally, it's time to dress up! Help us choose fashionable and elegant sports outfits to emphasize the fitness style of our heroine. Join Bonnie on her exciting journey to the perfect figure and style!

title: Winter Solitaire TriPeaks
description:
Take a break from the holiday bustle and unwind with Winter Solitaire TriPeaks!
Play over 500 frosty levels and clear shimmering, ice-covered tableaus. Escape into a peaceful winter wonderland filled with enchanting scenes that evolve as you build magical locations throughout the game. From a cozy cottage to a snow-dusted palace, every setting is a feast for the eyes.

Discover the most heart-warming Solitaire experience of the season — and let the snowflakes guide your cards to victory!

title: Guinea Piggy Matching
description:
Guinea Piggy Match uses well known and easy to learn game mechanics. Your target is to take apart a pattern made of tiles. 
For each completed level, you are given a golden puzzle piece. For these, you can uncover images of cute guinea piggies.

title: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets
description: Combine flowers in the relaxing atmosphere of a summer garden and earn coins! Sell your bouquets to customers and clear your garden of unwanted flowers with your pruning shears! Earn more coins than other players to take a place on the leaderboard!

title: Sheep Sheep Duck
description: Sheep Sheep Duck is a very novel casual multiplayer party interactive game. You are free to choose and match the battle scenarios to your liking. The game has all kinds of cool scenes. You can control the game character flexibly by tapping directly on the screen, and take more challenges here. Show off your ability to defeat more enemies in this game, so you can get more weapons. You can challenge yourself better with great strength, so you can unlock new game maps.

title: Wired Chicken Inc
description: Wired Chicken Inc is a fun casual game on yad.com. Do you dream of being a relaxed and free farmer and managing your farm? In this game, you can realize your dreams.
