description: Embark on a journey with your cute monsters and go through positive gates to build up your strength. This will help you defeat stronger enemies. Also watch out for traps and obstacles in your way. Try to reach your strongest form to defeat the final boss.

title: Soccer Snakes
description: Two wild, clumsy snakes competing in a soccer match is the perfect mix of humor, chaos, and sports. Play solo or share your keyboard with a friend and score some 'hiss-terical' fun with Soccer Snakes!

title: Royal Jewels Match
description: Matching jewels has never been so much fun! Unlock unique levels, participate in special events and take on surprising challenges. Collect coins with your matches and show off your decorating skills. Earn crowns as you progress and become a true master of the game!

title: Cashier Game
description: You play as a cashier who needs to punch the goods and give change to the customers. As you earn money, you can improve your store and buy new furnishings.

title: Moto Cabbie Simulator
description: Welcome to Moto Cabbie Simulator, where the thrill of the open road meets the fast-paced world of urban transportation! In this exhilarating and immersive gaming experience, players take on the role of a daring motorcycle taxi rider navigating the bustling streets of a vibrant city.

title: Mini Springs
description: Mini Springs is a retro-style platform game where you command a small blob character that can't jump; use the springs all over the stage to evade obstacles and reach your goal!

title: Evony The King's Return
description: Want to conquer the world? In Evony: The King's Return, step into a vast universe of war and zombie attacks. Command an army and use powerful weapons and guns to attack the enemy. Keep moving your soldiers, shoot digital doors, and expand your army! Keep shooting to get the gun. Face endless zombie waves with your shooting skills and unlock powerful weapons.

title: Italian Brainrot: Neuro Beasts
description:
Welcome to the world of Italian Neuro-Animals!
This is a clicker game featuring bizarre creatures generated by neural networks — get ready for chaos, memes, and pizza.

Collect them all! Level up like crazy! And may the Neuro-Pizza be with you

title: Fight to the end
description: Players control a protagonist, an assault soldier, who needs to keep moving and fend off enemy attacks during the battle to survive until the end. Each time the protagonist levels up, the player can choose one of three randomly offered buffs, which are divided into skill - type and bonus - type. Skill - type buffs allow the protagonist to add or enhance skills, while bonus - type buffs are related to the character.

title: Color 3D - Bump It Up
description:
The main principle is pretty simple – you are controlling a small ball that is always moving forward.

On your way, there are a few obstacles that you need to get through. There’s a small problem however, because you can only touch obstacles that are the same color as your ball. If you touch an obstacle with a different color, the game ends and you need to start from the beginning.

title: ROYAL COIN RUSH
description: Drag adjacent coins to swap them, and line up three or more vertically or horizontally to remove them. Special coins appear when 4 or more coins are matched. Mix effects by combining special items! The stage is cleared when all the target coins are erased.

title: Sky Riders
description: Sky Riders is a high-speed casual vehicle driving game. Put your driving skills to the test as you complete several challenging tracks.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Destruction of Stickman Zombie
description:
Take a weapon and destroy the zombie stickmen! "Destruction of Stick Zombie" is an exciting game in which you will fight against hordes of stickman zombies using your skills and strategies. You have to fight zombies to earn coins and improve your weapons.
You start the game as a regular player, but as you progress in the game, you become more experienced and skilled in combat. The more coins you earn, the more weapons and ammo you can buy.

title: Boss Market
description: You are the owner of your market. Customers are coming to buy various products. Collect these products and place them into correct stands so that customers can buy them. Collect money from customers and open new markets and become a market boss!

title: Worm: Apple Quest
description:
Get Ready for Challenging Puzzles in Worm: Apple Quest!

In this captivating puzzle platformer, guide your worm to the legendary Golden Apple while navigating devious obstacles and perilous chasms. The secret to success? Mastering your worm's growing length.

Every apple you collect makes your worm longer, unlocking new paths - but beware! With greater length comes tougher control. One wrong turn and you might get stuck, ending your run.

title: Ragdoll Beat - Simulator
description:
In "Ragdoll Beat - Simulator" you will find crazy levels, chaos physics and familiar characters! How far can you go, creating incredible moments with a ragdoll?

-Unique levels, where every object can become a tool of fun.
-Realistic ragdoll physics - push, throw and watch the result!
-The more you play, the more new situations you discover!

Jump into "Ragdoll Beat - Simulator" and check what chaos physics is capable of! Complete all the tests, open new opportunities and enjoy crazy fun!

title: Loop Ghost
description: Time loop puzzle: ghosts of your past cycles automatically repeat your moves. Use them to press buttons, open passages, and escape together.

title: Protect My Dog 3
description: Protect My Dog 3 is a fun casual puzzle game. The aim of the game is to protect our cute dog from bee attacks. For this, you must create a defensive drawing line at the levels. You should also protect your dog from lava, thorns and different environmental hazards. Fighting the Bees will continue for 100 Levels and things will get a little more difficult with each level.

title: Bears vs. Art
description:
Bears vs. Art is the premium version of the slash em’ up puzzle game you love! Exclusive to this version of Bears vs. Art - enjoy uninterrupted, thought-provoking puzzles.
Each painting is protected by sneaky security measures including lasers, spikes and mind-bending portals. Not to mention snooty guests, nosy security guards and art-snatching thieves!

title: Yummy Tales 3
description: Join Oscar, the clever farm dog, in Yummy Tales 3 — the fun and addictive Match 3 puzzle game! Match 3 or more fruits and veggies to feed your farm animals and reach level goals before you run out of moves. Enjoy over 2500+ exciting levels, daily missions, and challenges. Collect daily gifts, boosters, and fantastic rewards to help you beat tricky puzzles. Harvest the fun and start playing Yummy Tales 3 now!

title: Two Carts - Downhill
description: Two Carts - Downhill is a fast-paced arcade game where you control two carts simultaneously, each on its own obstacle-filled road. Use the left and right arrow keys to steer each cart independently, collecting components to score points. Pick up power-ups like Ice to slow down the game or Shield to protect against obstacles. As you progress, the game speeds up, challenging your reflexes and multitasking skills. How long can you keep both carts on track?

title: Merge 2048 Gun Rush
description: Merge 2048 Gun Rush is a pistol runner game. Combine guns of the same level to make more powerful guns. Stack as many guns as you can as a way to increase firepower. Slide to operate the guns, easy to learn and suitable for all ages. Can you win every game? Join us to give it a try! Good luck!

title: Lode Retro Adventure
description: Relive the classic fun of Lode Retro Adventure, a 2D pixel game that will make you dig for gold. You will play as a gold miner who must collect a certain amount of gold coins in each level. You will use your shovel to break the ground tiles and trap the purple monsters, but be careful, they can escape and chase you. You will also find other treasures such as golden bananas that will boost your score. Lode Retro Adventure is a game that will test your strategy. Can you collect all the gold coins?

title: Food Sort 3D
description:
In this game, you manage your own food court, sorting various food items into their respective categories. You'll encounter different eateries, from fast-food joints to upscale restaurants, each requiring you to sort items like burgers,
sushi, hotdog, fries, pizza and desserts. The game features colorful graphics and quick, satisfying levels that keep you engaged as you expand your food

title: Tidy Master Satisfeel ASMR
description: Looking for a relaxing yet satisfying game experience? Tidy Master - Satisfeel ASMR is here to deliver pure organizing joy. This addictive casual game lets you step into beautifully designed scenes where you tidy up and become a true organizing master. With multiple modes to explore - classic, outdoor, indoor, and even food-themed - you’ll find yourself cleaning up beaches, gardens, and more. Start organizing now and become the ultimate tidy master!

title: Clicker Hero
description: Click on the screen to defeat the monsters and earn gold in Clicker Hero. Spend your gold to buy and upgrade heroes that deal damage automatically. Then advance to fight tougher monsters that drop more gold. This game keeps going, even when you're offline, so come back later to earn and spend even more!

title: Emoji Merge Fun Moji
description: Welcome to Emoji Merge: Fun Moji! A fun and creative jigsaw puzzle that allows you to merge various funny emojis. Create super funny, super cute emoji combinations. It's not just a simple merger game and full of interesting challenges.

title: Build A Queen 2025
description: In Build a Queen 2025, you will embark on a fun journey to become a real queen. You will need to make your way through different platform levels with your opponents. Choose outfits, skin colors, and more according to your goals. Dress up in the most glamorous queen look, meet the prince, and win. You can collect money to unlock more dance steps.

title: Crazy Bunnies
description: An exciting platformer about super bunnies in which you have to go through levels created in the style of Minecraft. There is a single and cooperative mode.

title: Deadflip Frenzy
description:
Deadflip Frenzy is a wild stunt-flipping action game where chaos meets style! Launch your character into the air, pull off insane flips, twists, and bone-crunching landings — all in the name of fun (and maybe a little destruction).

Bounce off trampolines, launch from cannons, smash through obstacles, and aim for the most outrageous combos. The more insane your flip, the higher your score. But beware — one bad landing and it’s ragdoll mayhem!

title: Brilliant Jewels
description: Brilliant Jewels is a Match 3 game where you can either play against the time or try to pass levels with limited amount of moves. If you are feeling confident, you can also challenge the hard mode on the time attack mode. This game doesn't lack any sparkle!

title: Find the Sprunki
description: Find out the hidden Sprunki in the specified images. Each level has 12 hidden Sprunki. There are 12 levels in total. The time is limited so be fast and find all hidden objects before time runs out. Clicking in the wrong place several times reduces the time by an additional 5 seconds. So, if you are ready, start the game and have fun!

title: StickMan Gunner
description: StickMan Gunner is a fast-paced running game that puts players in control of a powerful gun zipping through levels. You guide it to pick up stickmen along the way, building up your crew while smashing through obstacles and enemies that pop up. It’s straightforward gameplay that keeps things moving without much downtime, making it a solid pick for short sessions during study breaks or downtime.

title: Tetro Merge
description:
Tetro Merge is a physics-based merge puzzle game where Tetromino blocks come to life.
You’ll drop Tetrominoes of all shapes—classic, extended, and brand-new originals. When two matching pieces touch, they merge into a bigger, more complex block.
Master the bounce, plan your stacks, and build powerful combos as the board slowly fills up.
Will you manage your space wisely… or let the blocks overflow?
A perfect blend of strategy, physics, and classic Tetris nostalgia.

title: Thief Puzzle
description: Thief Puzzle is a clever 2D puzzle logic game that puts your problem-solving and strategy to the test. You control a sneaky thief’s hand as it reaches for valuable treasures, but the path is filled with complex traps, laser security systems, and tricky obstacles.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Alien Hunters
description: A fast-paced game where you will play a role of a robot hunter with a deadly dagger of light. With multiple enemies to kill, and a lot of challenging missions to complete, this game will take you on a captivating and thrilling adventure.

title: Robot Band - Find the Differences
description:
Spot all the differences you can find in the pictures of these lively robots playing their instruments and do it fast!
Try to find all the differences in each picture before the time runs out. Be careful though: Do not touch the screen randomly trying to catch all the differences this way!
If you touch the screen 5 times without touching one of the differences is game over!

title: Monster Makeup 3D
description: Show off your makeup skills by helping monsters blend seamlessly into human society. Protect them by keeping their true identities hidden from angry mobs. Transform monsters to hide in plain sight, ensuring their survival. Customize their look by choosing skin color, changing eye lenses, adjusting their teeth, and adding the perfect wig to complete their human disguise. But be careful—make a mistake, and you might become the monster's next meal!

title: Miner's Fury!
description:
Miner's Fury! Avoid and destroy!

Clear and destroy rock waves. Lookout for mystery rocks too! Buy and deploy Turrets to breeze through levels. 
Collect the coins that drop from the destroyed rocks, and spend them buying Turrets, and to Upgrade yourself. Upgrades will make you deal more damage faster, earn more coins, as well as improving your spawned Turrets.
Lookout for Missions to earn rewards!

Made with ❤️ by Realinspirer

title: Timewalker: Survive!
description: Time Walker: Survive – Embark on a thrilling journey through apocalyptic landscapes in this fast-paced 2D top-down survival game! As a Timewalker, battle relentless hordes of zombies across different eras, fighting for survival against increasingly intense waves of the undead.

title: Word Stars
description: Find hidden words and piece together your success. Each puzzle is a step towards mastering the game and expanding your word power. Use hints to keep progressing. From the first word to the last, it’s a race to finish all the levels.

title: Two RX7 Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful rx7. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Shelf Shift Match
description: Test your strategy and speed in Shelf Shift Match! Shift items on the shelves to create perfect matches of three, clearing the way to reveal hidden shadowed items. But beware—unwise moves can block your shelves, leaving no space to shift and leading to game over! If you're stuck, use the shuffle button to mix things up and find new matches.

title: Ellie and Ben Christmas Eve
description: Celebrate the magic of the holiday season with Ellie and Ben Christmas Eve, a delightful game where players join Ellie and Ben as they prepare for the most wonderful night of the year. From decorating the tree to picking the perfect outfits, this game brings the charm of Christmas to life in a fun and interactive way.

title: Geometry Vertical
description: In Poligon Dash - Geometry, you find yourself entangled in an adrenaline-fueled run against time and various geometric obstacles. This game offers a dynamic mix of speed, calculations, and precision. With each level being a new challenge filled with exciting twists and turns, your journey to the finish line will keep you on your toes

title: Toy Match 3
description: Toy Match 3 is the third sequel to one of our cutest Match 3 puzzle games! Get ready for colorful graphics, fun animations, and a catchy soundtrack. Match adorable toys in over 4,100+ exciting levels and take on Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges! Embark on thrilling quests like the Treasure Hunt for amazing rewards. With tons of extras and surprises, Toy Match 3 is pure puzzle fun. Start playing now for free!

title: Save the cats - Bubble shooter
description:
Think strategically, aim, shoot and get rid of all the bubbles.

Explore hundreds of levels with different levels of difficulty.

Be as accurate as possible to free all the cats.

Buy and use boosters on challenging levels.

To win - clear the field of all the balloons.

title: 12-in-1 Solitaire
description:
Solitaire is one of the most popular – if not the most popular – card games in the world! Experience premium Solitaire gameplay at its best with 12 of the world's most popular Solitaire games!

Welcome to our latest & most comprehensive collection of the world's best & most popular Solitaire games! We included 12 of the most beloved Solitaire games in 1 comphrehensive collection, added helpful features appreciated by both Solitaire pros and amateurs alike.

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Your favorite pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to save them and punish the alien bullies. Evolve to defeat stronger enemies, free new dogs, get unique resources so that your dogs can evolve! Collect all the dog breeds and see how cool they will be! Discover new territories, visit the beach, park, city square and forest!

title: Word Art – Color Book Puzzle
description: Discover a delightful gaming experience that combines the thrill of solving word puzzles with the joy of bringing art to life. In Word Art – Color Book Puzzle, you’ll embark on a creative journey where words are the key to unlocking vibrant colors and stunning illustrations.

title: My Perfect Organization
description: Searching for relaxing casual games? Want to get a pastime challenge and leisure? Why dont you try this mini games collection-Home Packing! Here you will find ten more different kinds little puzzles full of packing fun, each has its own packing charm. No more brain teasers, just enjoy the fun of puzzle solving! Organize the whole house with your own hand, create a tidy life through organizing games and sorting games!

title: People Playground: Ragdoll Battle
description:
Welcome to People Playground: Ragdoll Battle!
Carefully control your character to strike the right spots on your opponent’s body. Attack strategically to destroy and crush your enemies. Earn gold coins to unlock new characters and upgrade your skills.
Have fun and dominate the arena!

title: Delta Force Airborne
description:
This game offers a whole new level of graphics and sound design that completely immerses you in a realistic atmosphere of battles. 
Shoot and use tactical thinking to overcome obstacles and achieve victory together with your team. 
Explore a variety of maps, each of which is full of unique opportunities and strategic points.
Become a master of team play by coordinating with your teammates and using different character classes to create the perfect strategy.

title: Quackventure
description: Join Quack, the brave duck, on an exhilarating journey through a magical forest brimming with wonder and hidden secrets. Explore enchanting landscapes, solve intriguing mysteries, and embark on an adventure filled with thrilling surprises and endless excitement at every corner!

title: Real Cars Epic Stunts
description:
Flashy and modified super-sports cars and their drivers are ready for the show in Real Cars Epic Stunts game. Play against time in dozens of different stunt tracks and try to complete the show. Unlock new cars or upgrade your car with the coins and diamonds you collect.

Game Features:

● Realistic car physics and appearance. ( Cars get crushed and smashed )
● Upgradeable cars
● 1 Player and 2 Player modes
● Mega ramps for epic stunts

title: Frost Defense
description:
❄️ Embark on a thrilling journey through a frozen wilderness in Frost Defense, a strategic tower defense game that puts your tactical skills to the test! ??

In this action-packed adventure, you'll take on the role of a lone survivor ?‍♂️ battling against the relentless onslaught of arctic creatures ??‍❄️?.
The enemy is merciless — only your ingenuity and strategic prowess can keep you alive in this harsh frozen world. ⚔️?️

title: BMG: CrashDay 2025
description: The game "BMG: CrashDay 2025" is an arcade racing simulator that combines elements of action and realism. Players can choose from a variety of cars, each with its own unique characteristics and appearance. The game has various tracks, each with its own features, such as difficult turns, steep climbs and descents, as well as various obstacles.

title: Horse Champs
description: Raise, train, and compete with your champion horse to secure first place in this thrilling horse racing simulation game. Strategize and master the art of competition.

title: Find It In The Haunted Mansion
description: “Find It In The Haunted Mansion” is a finding style game, where you are a detective and need to find all the keys hidden in each part of the house to complete all the levels.

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: Number Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West number bubble shooter! Shoot and match numbers to merge them into higher values, creating bigger combos and clearing the board. Plan your shots, stack smart, and ride through dusty levels full of challenge and fun!

title: Force Master 3D
description: Force Master 3D is a battle Math online game for boys for free. In the game, all the enemies are waiting for you at each level. You need to give priority to attacking monsters lower than yourself. The more monsters you attack, the higher your level will be. Be sure to pay attention to your own strength, because only in this way can you not be destroyed by the enemy!

title: Word Search Universe 2
description: Word Search Universe 2 is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you find hidden words across many themed levels. Explore categories like science, history, food, nature, and more while sharpening your focus and vocabulary. Simply swipe letters to form words, complete challenges, and unlock new chapters. With clean visuals, smooth controls, and hundreds of words to discover.

title: Merge Flowers
description:
Merge Flowers is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game! Grow your vibrant garden, discover unique flowers, and earn coins. Enjoy merge puzzle and match-3 mechanics as you combine flowers to create a blooming paradise.
With simple controls and cozy visuals, place flowers strategically to make space for new plants. Perfect for puzzle lovers and fans of casual idle games, Merge Flowers offers endless fun and a soothing experience. Start your floral journey today!

title: Sea Battle Admiral
description:
Do you remember your favorite childhood entertainment with paper and pencils?
Then, immerse yourself in the exciting sea battles on your device's screen.
The classic paper-based tabletop naval combat game is here!
Enjoy exciting naval battles, strategy, and adrenaline.

title: Popping Candies
description: Match and crush candies to achieve goals in this addictive puzzle game! Swap adjacent candies to form rows of three or more and clear the board. Create special candies like striped, wrapped, or color bombs to enhance your progress. Overcome obstacles like chocolate and blockers while completing each level's unique objectives. Be mindful of your limited moves! Use boosters for extra assistance and advance through challenging levels to unlock new stages.

title: Overflowing Palette
description:
Test your puzzle-solving skills in Overflowing Palette! Pick the perfect colors, flood the board, and fill every tile before your moves run out. You'll find plenty of levels with different mechanics, an endless mode without a move counter if you want to relax, and the ability to create and share your own levels.

Credits
Based on the puzzle of the same name from the game "Wuthering Waves " by Kuro Games.

title: Marble Puzzle Quest
description: Marble Puzzle Quest is a fun and addictive casual puzzle game where your task is to sort colorful marbles into the correct slots. With each new level, the challenge grows — chains become longer and more colorful, while the space for moves gets tighter. Use logic, plan ahead, and clear the board! Watch out: the marbles fill four slots at the top, and only three of the same color will disappear. Place them incorrectly, and you lose the round.

title: Grand Theft NY
description:
This amazing 3D game is a free online take on the legendary Grand Theft Auto game. As you play, you'll take control of a thief with assignments all throughout New York City. You have complete freedom to run and explore the game's open world.

Using the arrows to guide you to the control points, you must sprint across the city and complete over ten interactive levels.

In each level, you have the option to play missions with certain goals or just explore the world at your leisure.

title: Noob Village Tower Defense
description: Dive into the dynamic world of a 2D platformer, where you play as a noob fighting for the survival of your village! Your main goal is to protect the village from endless waves of monsters appearing from an ominous portal. Control the tower manually: select shells, adjust the trajectory and shoot enemies one by one. Only your accuracy and tactics will help you survive the onslaught!

title: Snake Puzzle Escape
description: Get ready for a fast-paced puzzle experience where your goal is to wiggle the snake through each grid while avoiding obstacles and other snakes. With simple controls and a variety of challenging levels, this is the perfect game for quick play during your free time.

title: Block Cut Cleaner
description: An original block puzzle where the field is filled with triangle blocks! Pull out your shapes and place them on the field to clear at 100%. But be careful: each piece you place can create new blocks! Use smart boosters to turn the tide: refresh your inventory, remove three random triangles or place a "clean" square that doesn't leave blocks behind. Plan your strategy to clear the board completely!

title: Count Masters: Stickman Games
description: Count Masters: Stickman Games is a fast-paced running game where you gather a growing army of stickmen to clash against rival crowds. Navigate through obstacles, choose the best paths to multiply your numbers, and lead your team to victory.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Emilys Hotel Solitaire
description: What are you going to do when you go on a journey to a tropical island? Will you spend your time in a lounger, enjoying the hot sun and cold drinks, or become a master surfer? Our heroine Emily has arrived at this heavenly place to make her honorable grandfather Douglas Kirby’s dream to build a hotel of his own come true.

title: Extreme Car Race Master 3D
description: Fine tune your ride, keep your foot on the gas, dodge the endlessly varied obstacles, and try to keep out the way of your equally manic rivals in super-fast, super-exciting, psychedelic races that always offer something new and unexpected. Feel the need for speed?

title: Madness Cars Destroy
description:
The game features 6 unique modes:

Funnel: Push cars into the abyss as the funnel narrows!
Rotating Cube: Stay on the spinning cube, which speeds up over time!
Deadly Arena: Dodge falling bombs and collapsing floors—or shoot players instead!
Right Color: Inspired by Roblox, but with cars!
Deadly Bouncers: Avoid spinning mines in a gladiator-style arena!
Hot Potato: Pass the bomb or explode!
Choose from foreign or Russian cars and dive into the action!

title: Sword Run 3D
description: Sword Run 3D is an easy to pick up action runner game. Collect sword pieces, cut off the obstacles that block your progress, and finally reach the finish line to win. More cool skins are waiting for you to unlock, what are you waiting for? Don't forget to share it with your friends if it's fun!

title: Fruit Merge Arena
description: Fruit Merge Arena is a fun and relaxing game where you drop fruits and merge the same ones to create bigger fruits. Keep merging step by step and try to reach the ultimate fruit — the watermelon! But be careful, space is limited and the board can fill up quickly. Plan your moves wisely and keep merging to stay in the game.Feeling stuck or running out of space? Don’t worry! You can watch a reward ad to remove all instances of a selected fruit and make room for new moves.

title: Minitoss
description: Score goals, protect your goal and beat all your opponents. Keep competing until you are the king and the best on the pitch.

title: Troll The Teacher
description:
Laugh and prank the teacher in this fun school game!

Have you ever dreamed of playing a prank on your teacher? Now you have a chance! In this game, you will become a student who arranges funny pranks right during the lesson. Use the most unexpected "tools", upgrade them and watch the funny reactions of the teacher!

title: The Lost City - Match 3
description:
Hit three in a row and get a crazy field explosion!
Use colorful booster effects that will make the game even more fun and colorful!
No stressful time restrictions! Enjoy the adventure freely!
Go through a wide selection of mysterious and mystical stages.
Complete various levels and get happiness from breaking gems!

title: Word Voyager
description:
Word Voyager - Embark on the ultimate quest for words,right on your touchscreen!

Solve puzzles and expand your vocabulary smoothly.

Follow Olivia, your trusty guide, as she navigates you through the gentle murmurs of an ancient library. Uncover secrets during the 'Daily Mission'. Find hidden stars that unlock new thematic categories that will take you on a odyssey through the infinite universe of words.

title: Riders Downhill Racing
description: Get ready to join the riders in an exciting adventure with Riders Downhill Racing! Choose from various game modes, including free ride, race, and career, available in both 1 player and 2 player modes. Experience the thrill of riding different vehicles, such as ATV bikes, cross bikes, and speed boats, while wearing different costumes. Join any mode and have a blast! Remember to collect diamonds during the free ride to unlock more items.

title: 3D Ball Balancer
description: 3D Ball Balancer is a fun 3D rolling ball game. Control the ball to roll on the floating bridge. There are obstacles all over the floating bridge, including broken bridges, ramps, single-plank bridges, etc. Not only do you have to control the direction of the ball, but you also have to control the speed of the ball. How far you can go? Have a try!

title: Barry Prison Christmas Adventure
description: Want the craziest Christmas escape adventure ever? Barry Prison Christmas Adventure is an exciting role-playing simulator. Enter chase mode or evade mode. Here, you will play the role of either the hider or the seeker. Select your preferred scenario to begin the challenge. Find a hidden spot to start hiding and evade your pursuers.

title: Shanghai Chef
description:
A fun and fast-paced matching game where you need to find and connect the same blocks! 
Test your reflexes and observation skills as you quickly spot matching pairs. 
Can your hands move faster than your eyes can track? 
Pay close attention to which blocks can be linked together and clear the board as fast as possible!

title: Santa Go
description:
Santa Go is a cozy Christmas puzzle game where you help Santa reach his sleigh!
Draw a line for Santa to slide along and watch him glide under a cheerful holiday melody.
Be careful — with each level, more obstacles appear, and they can easily knock Santa down.
Your goal is to guide him into the sleigh and keep him there for 3 seconds to complete the level!

title: Paw Clash
description: Paw Clash is an exciting party game where cute animals compete in fun challenges. Enjoy a variety of mini-games that test your skills and reflexes in colorful environments. With simple controls and increasing difficulty, Paw Clash offers endless fun for players of all ages.

title: West Frontier Sharpshooter 3D
description: Have you ever dreamed of being a cowboy in a world like A Fistful of Dollars? Then this game is made for you! This is a Western-style sniper game, take your Winchester Model 1894 to kill all the bandits, and bring justice to this land!  Carefully plan the order of killing and don't let the covering fire kill you! Sometimes head-on confrontations are inevitable, all the bandits are firing, but you are ready for this, show them the power of your M1873!

title: Obby Pinata Party
description: Help the Obby guy to fight those pinatas and Explore the world. Choose from wide variety of weapons, collect coins and upgrade them. Make the pinatas give you every penny they have!

title: Mutant run
description: When you are running on a track full of various obstacles, you need to choose to go through the mutation gate to evolve your body, gain the talents of specific animals, and clear the obstacles in the road!

title: Dragon Egg
description: Players can unlock higher-level Divine Dragon eggs by moving three or more of them. Supports multi-level recursive synthesis of 5-color dragon eggs. Eventually, unlocking high-level dragon eggs can unlock the birth of new dragons, accompanied by splendid animations, filling the sense of achievement to the fullest.

title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
description: Choose one of two Brainrots, transform into them, and engage in intense battles with other players. Defeat opponents and unlock new abilities: a Brainrot morph, unique weapons, and powerful abilities. Every battle is a chance to prove yourself! At level 5, you'll unlock a protective shield, and at level 10, you'll unlock slow-motion , which will give you a huge advantage in battle. Earn titles for your victories, from "Noob" to a true "Pro"!

title: Last Day On Earth Survival
description: Last Day on Earth: Survival is a 2D survival simulation game. In this large ruined city, you have 51 locations to discover. When you collect some wood and metal, you can make weapons on the Workbench. When you win enough experience and level up, you can check your Attribute and upgrade HP, ATK, Speed, and Search. In the day, explore and go to places you have never visited. I hope you will survive 50 days and explore all 51 locations.

title: Party Animals Cats Evolution
description:
**Gameplay:** Creating a cat has never been easier!  Just click on identical kittens, connect them together and get new types!  Go through all the stages of cats evolution and populate the planet with Party Animals!
Cats themselves generate coins - use them to buy additional cats, or boosters to improve the game!

**Content:** Discover 21 unique and cute party animals, each with a name as distinctive as their personality and a wonderful description that brings out their individual charm.

title: Pinball VS Zombie
description: Dive into Pinball Zombie Defense, the ultimate fusion of pinball chaos and zombie tower defense! Plant defensive flora to create a ricocheting battlefield where high-speed pinballs smash into plants, unleashing bullet barrages on undead waves. Auto-collect sunlight to grow stronger defenses and hold the line—don't let a single zombie reach your house!

title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
description:
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem is an exciting motorcycle racing game. 
In this game you will become a motorcycle racer who travels through city streets and highways, avoiding collisions with other vehicles. You will be able to unlock faster and more powerful motorcycles, each with its own unique handling characteristics, as well as improve the characteristics of your motorcycle. One of the key features of the game is a realistic physics engine that makes the gameplay challenging and exciting.

title: Real Motorbike Super Hero Stunt 3D
description: In this bike racing game performs insane stunts to impress. In bike stunts game you can show different type of stunts like jumping in the air and drifting as stunts man. Ride your bike in motorbike simulator 3d city environment while doing a stunt as a great biker for bike lovers.

title: Sprunki Torches Maze
description: Light up all the torches in the room to unlock the door. Some torches are linked and will toggle together when activated. Watch out for bats! Contact with them results in a game over! Your goal is to exit the house through the front yard door.

title: Snow Rider Obby Parkour
description:
Snow Rider Obby Parkour is a fast-paced snowboard adventure where reflexes, timing, and control matter. Play solo or with a friend in split-screen mode and experience different snow challenges across multiple game modes. Whether you want to beat distance records, explore a massive open world, or race down dangerous mountains, this game offers a complete snowboarding experience.

Master your snowboard, perform double jumps, and unlock amazing gear to customize your character!

title: angry snake io
description: Angry Snake io " is an exciting and addictive arcade game where you take control of a fierce, hungry snake on a mission to grow, survive, and dominate the arena! Slither through a vibrant world, gobbling up colorful orbs to grow longer and stronger. But watch out—danger lurks around every corner! Avoid obstacles, outsmart traps, and navigate increasingly challenging levels as your snake grows bigger and faster.

title: Climb Up!
description: In this challenging adventure, you'll embark on a perilous ascent up a massive, treacherous mountain. Navigate slippery surfaces and unpredictable obstacles as you make your way towards the summit, where eternal glory and a rewarding gift await. Will you be able to overcome the many hurdles and reach the top, or will the climb prove too daunting? Your determination and skill will be tested as you brave the unknowns of this grueling climb.

title: Pesky Moles
description:
An ordinary farmer lived a quiet life and grew vegetables, but at some point, moles began to attack his garden and eat the entire crop.
After the next harvest, he decides to take everything into his own hands and protect his garden.
In Pesky Moles, you have to protect your garden from moles for a certain amount of time. The more pests you manage to neutralize and the more crops you save, the more coins you get. With the coins you earn, you can buy traps that will help you protect your garden.

title: Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop
description:
"Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop" – A Charming Puzzle Game About Merging Jelly Dolls!

In this addictive game, you'll drop adorable Labubu dolls, match identical ones, and create new characters! When two matching Labubus collide, they transform into the next doll in your collection. Earn coins for every merge, then spend them to operate the claw machine – fish out exactly the Labubu you need to complete each level!

Can you collect all the Labubus?

title: 67 Clicker
description:
Forget everything you know about gaming. Experience the absolute peak of interactive entertainment. It’s not just a number; it’s a lifestyle. Tap the 67 and watch your empire grow.

FULLY AUTOMATED STONKS: Buy upgrades to make the 67 click itself. It’s literally free real estate.

PEAK BRAIN ROT: No thoughts, just 67. The perfect idle experience for fans of "number go up" simulators.

title: Chicken Strike
description: Meet the new exciting third-person shooter - Chicken Strike! Here you will act as a brave chicken who fights with opponents in different conditions. Buy a variety of skins to make your chicken unique. Enjoy jumping like a real chicken. Get ready for intense battles and become a true chicken champion!

title: Racing Car Destroying Zombie
description:
Zombie Racing Car fast-paced physics-based racing game. You’re in for the ride of your life through a zombie apocalypse!

Drive your car through deserts, forests, abandoned city,...surrounded by zombies, earn cash, upgrade your car powerful ones. Steer your car to keep balance on the hills while trying to smash zombies into debris. It's you against a boatload of super-strong zombies!

title: GenFire
description:
GenFire is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where players fight endless waves of enemies in intense 360° combat.

Survive increasingly difficult levels, defeat elemental creatures, and collect coins while mastering your strategy.

Features:
- 20 handcrafted levels across multiple chapters
- Unique enemy mechanics including splitting fire slimes and bosses
- Skill-based gameplay with increasing difficulty

title: Emoji Drop Themes
description: Dive into the addictive fun of Emoji Drop, a delightful physics puzzle game where strategy meets chain reactions! Drop a variety of charming items, from classic emojis and juicy fruits to wild animals into the container. The magic happens when two matching items touch, merging into something new and bigger. With a challenging Adventure Mode and a relaxing Classic Mode, can you master the merge and discover the final, ultimate item?

title: Gross Out Run
description: Gross Out Run is a parkour game. Compete against two other AI runners and the first player to reach the finish line wins! Be careful, you have to avoid the sledgehammers on the road, which will block your progress and stain your clothes simultaneously. It's time to make a change! Can you get to the finish line first and keep yourself tidy?

title: Boyfriend For Hire
description: Pushed by her mom to start dating, studious Amy hires charming transfer student Javier to pose as her boyfriend. Rival Christie, jealous rumors, and a flirty study partner turn the act into real complications. Choose outfits, make tough choices, and decide if this love is real—or just for show.

title: Barbee Met Gala Transformation
description: Barbee and her friends have a big night ahead—the Met Gala! It’s your job to help each of them get dressed up and feel amazing. Whether someone’s into bold colors or classic glam, you get to style their look from head to toe and make sure they’re ready to walk the red carpet.

title: Cool Cars: racing at altitude
description:
Cool Cars: racing at altitude is an exciting racing game in which you can buy cars, build your own garage and compete with other players.

Earn points by collecting bonuses on a straight track, compete with other players to complete special tracks against the clock, equip your auto repair shop and collect cool cars!
In the game you will find a large number of cars, exciting tracks, your own garage with purchased cars, the ability to change the environment to suit you and much more.

title: Fashionista Avatar Studio Dress Up
description: It is a fun, creative dress-up and hairstyling game for all ages. Players mix and match outfits, hairstyles, and accessories to create stylish looks. The game features cute characters, diverse clothing options, and a salon scene for designing unique hairstyles, colors, and headpieces. Enjoy endless fashion fun and creativity in a joyful, relaxed atmosphere.

title: My horse is amazing
description:
Ride a horse and overcome obstacles: fences, pits and water obstacles. Control the jumps — tap and release to jump accurately.

Collect powerups with powerups — increase attack and health. The further you run, the stronger your horse becomes!

Your steed is growing: it's getting faster and more powerful. Upgrade it and keep running. At the end of each level is a boss battle! Show what you are capable of!

title: Slicer Duo
description: Slicer Duo is a satisfying ASMR game where precision, timing, and rhythm come together in a sharp slicing adventure. Move through level-based stages, cut through fruits and all kinds of objects, collect points, and try to keep your knife in motion for as long as possible. While the controls are simple, every section demands focus because one bad move can send your knife straight into danger.

title: PaperWar.io
description: There are so many unexplored areas! Conquering them is the key to mastering the game. Expand your territory, eliminate other players who threaten your progress and aim to conquer 100% of each new map. Choose from 9 special skins to express your style!

title: The Trendy Mermaid
description: Embark on an exciting journey of makeup, accessories, and fashion to help Ariel make an unforgettable comeback. With a wide selection of clothes, makeup, and accessories, help Ariel become the trendiest mermaid ever. Enjoy making her look dreamy and fabulous - The Trendy Mermaid is free to play for every girl.

title: Neko's Adventure
description: Neko’s Adventure is a vibrant platformer starring Neko, a playful cat trying to rescue his girlfriend. Explore 20 challenging levels, unlock the Power Beam to shoot fire, and face quirky enemies in a whimsical, fast-paced adventure full of charm, excitement, and cartoon fun!

title: Fashion Heroes Academy
description: Welcome to the Academy of Fashion Heroines, a place where style and superpowers go hand in hand! Three brave girls entered the academy in order not only to reveal their abilities, but also to create their own unique image. And you will help them in this. Choose outfits for studying, training and super battles. Experiment with makeup and accessories. Let each schoolgirl become a superhero and a style icon at the same time!

title: Space Pin Master - Pull Pin Puzzle
description: Relax and challenge your brain with Space Pin Master! Enjoy satisfying pull pin puzzles in a space adventure full of gravity-based fun. Free the balls, avoid bombs and obstacles to fill the spaceship. Spin to win coins and unlock new balls, pins, spaceships, and themes. Simple yet addictive gameplay with stunning graphics and innovative levels. Ready to become the pull pin master? Jump in and start the space puzzle adventure!

title: Ice fishing 3d
description:
❄ Fishing is a great kind of recreation and an opportunity to spend time with excitement! If you are a real fisherman at heart and are ready to test your skills, then this ice fishing game is just for you.

? Wherever you are in winter or summer - you can always find yourself on snow-covered ice among beautiful winter landscapes. Drill, rod, bait and a lake that always bites, what else does a born fisherman need?

title: Egg Farm
description:
Join the egg-citing adventure of Egg Farm and unleash your inner fox as you embark on a fast-paced egg-catching frenzy! 
Dash with lightning agility, master obstacle evasion, and craft a fox character like no other with a range of custom skins. It's time to become an egg-cellent egg-catching maestro - your prowess will earn you legendary status!

title: RPG Idle Clicker
description: Join the adventure in RPG Idle Clicker, a thrilling idle RPG where you slay monsters with a single tap! Click to deal damage, earn gold, and unlock powerful swords to boost your clicks. Upgrade your blades and recruit auto-attacking heroes who fight monsters every second, even offline. With stunning visuals, face tougher foes and epic bosses in this browser-based game. Perfect for active players or idle fans, RPG Idle Clicker offers endless progression!

title: Oil Tanker Transport Truck
description: Let's go on to ride with an oil tanker transporter truck across all the continents like the Euro, Asia, and America oil transporter truck game has real features in the Euro and American cargo systems of the fuel truck.

title: Ancient Wars: Caesar
description: Ancient Wars: Caesar is an exciting strategy game in which you lead an army and fight for supremacy on the battlefield. The game takes you to the world of epic battles where tactics, planning and proper utilization of resources are important. Control various units, including warriors, archers and generals, to destroy enemy troops and destroy their base.

title: Word Scramble - Family Tales
description: Want a distraction from the annoyances of daily life, or is your brain tired of solving exactly the same problems? Welcome to Word Scramble: Family Tales! Train your gray matter by solving word search puzzles and level up your vocabulary! An exciting family adventure, colorful locations and engaging play make this game hard to tear yourself away from. The story of a long-awaited child finally arriving in a family will come to life literally in front of your eyes.

title: Typing Adventure
description: Get ready for a fast-paced typing challenge in Typing Adventure! Type the words above each enemy to defeat them before they get too close. The longer you survive, the faster they come! How long can your fingers keep up? Battle endless waves and test your speed in this thrilling typing survival game!

title: Sky Maze Challenge
description: Perfect your jumps, defy gravity, and showcase your unmatched eye-hand coordination. Sky Maze Challenge demands precision and timing to overcome all of the traps and obstacles to conquer

title: Fish Love Pins
description: Fish Love Pins is a physics-based game that requires players to actively use their brains to figure out how to complete each level. The game is very easy to play, but as you progress through the levels, the difficulty gradually increases.

title: Mega Ramp Car
description:
Mega Ramp Car is a game with maximum speed and huge jumps! Are you ready to make the biggest leap in history?

Mega Ramp Car Features
- Realistic physics and sound effects.
- Real car collection
- This game allows you to perform amazing stunts on different jumps.
- Complete multiple levels and game modes for non-stop fun!
- You have to complete many challenging missions, which makes the game even more exciting.

Buy new cars to win new races.

title: Circle Run Endless
description: Circle Challenge is an endless game, you need to keep the circle not touch the line. Collect the gifts and using it to buy the circle in the shop.

title: Stickman in space
description:
You have to play as a Stickman astronaut who is stuck on the moon.
Use all possible ways to leave the moon and get to our planet Earth.
On the way you will encounter various dangers, such as aliens, flying meteorites and much more.
You will have several objects in your hands with which you can try to escape from the natural satellite of the moon. Several objects will lead you to death, and some objects can save your life, be careful and cautious.

title: Sniper 3D Zombie
description: Defend your position from the zombie invasion. You have a sniper rifle, find and eliminate zombies. Hitting a zombie is not difficult, it is much more difficult to detect it. The enemies are cunning and very well disguised, they are able to blend in with the environment. Shoot the zombies and take the first places in the leaderboard!

title: Super Tank Wrestle
description: Welcome to the world of tank battles, where you can control tanks to fight with other enemies on different maps. There are also a wealth of tanks for you to choose from!

title: Dusty Cat
description: Help the little speck of dust to grow into a real cat! Eat other dust, avoid larger enemies and grow to see all the phases of your Dusty Cat! Collect points and compete with other players to get your scores on the leaderboard!

title: TB Avataria Life Girl
description:
Hey, how about helping me decorate my house? You need to decorate my home beautifully, buy me nice clothes, and feed me. Let's get started — right now, I have an empty house, and we need to furnish it together. Let's make it look organized and cozy! Before I get too hungry, you must take me to the café to eat, or I might lose my life from hunger!
We also need to earn money. To make money, reach the computer and use the money-making app. You can either buy things or continue earning more money!

title: Exit - Puzzle
description: Embark on an exciting journey in Exit - Puzzle, a captivating game where your mission is to rotate the puzzle and guide the ball to the exit! Each level presents new challenges, requiring you to think creatively and find the best route. Twist and turn the puzzle to navigate through obstacles and unlock the path forward. With a variety of levels and progressively harder puzzles, this game will keep you entertained and engaged.

title: Emoji Frenzy
description:
Test your reflexes and knowledge in this fast-paced emoji matching game! 
Tap the correct emoji before time runs out, build streaks, and unlock new themes. Simple to play, hard to master!

title: VSCO Girl Aesthetic
description: Welcome to the VSCO Girl Aesthetic. Rainbow High school girls Sunny, Skyler, Ruby, and Violet are the trendy fashion girls. They planned to try VSCO fashion which is trending all over social media. Join and browse their wardrobe to pick some suitable outfits for the girls. Play and Have fun!

title: Zombies Weapon Merge 4
description: Zombies are swarming. Are you ready to fight back? Zombies 4 – Weapon Merge is an exciting shooting and strategy game where every decision matters. Match and merge weapons to create powerful guns, then aim and shoot endless waves of zombies. Combine identical weapons, upgrade your firepower, and place them smartly to survive tougher enemies.

title: My Tiny Market
description: In My Tiny Market, you're the boss of your very own supermarket. Manage your time and resources well to find the perfect balance between all your tasks: restock shelves, serve customers and keep everything running at full speed!

title: Robby: Bomberman
description:
Dive into an exciting adventure with Robby, a brave hero who finds himself trapped in a labyrinth filled with ghosts and mysterious loot boxes. In this danger-filled world, to unlock the exit, Robby must defeat all the ghosts and destroy the crates, which may contain precious coins and useful bonuses.

But Robby is not alone in his fight! He has a loyal ally—a magical mushroom that can emerge from the loot boxes to assist him in battles against the ghosts.

title: Minicraft Winterblock
description: Winter has arrived, and everything is covered in snow. In the snow-covered forest, you must be very careful to survive. You need to find two chests and collect all the snowballs. But be cautious, there are monsters everywhere waiting to eat you. You must defeat the monsters and reach the hidden portal at the end of the level. You must leave the house safely and pass through the portal.

title: Sudoku Master
description: Sudoku by in8finity is a classic puzzle game with a sleek dark theme, offering a smooth and enjoyable experience. Flexible settings let you adjust the difficulty to match your skill level. With intuitive controls and eye-friendly visuals, you can focus on solving puzzles without distractions. More than just a game, Sudoku trains logic, concentration, and memory. Challenge yourself and enjoy relaxing, distraction-free gameplay!

title: Sprunki Coloring Book
description:
Dive into a colorful adventure with Sprunki Coloring Book, a delightful game designed for kids and adults alike. Choose from a wide variety of adorable Sprunki characters, captivating landscapes, and fun designs to color your way. Whether you're a budding artist or simply looking to relax, Sprunki Coloring Book offers endless possibilities for self-expression.
Start coloring today and discover the joy of creativity with Sprunki Coloring Book!

title: Fire snake
description: Help the fire snake slither safely home! Dodge dangerous obstacles, collect shiny coins, and master tricky levels. Can you guide the snake through every challenge? Play now and test your skills!

title: ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa
description: ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa is a relaxing style game where you guide a charming girl through a soothing Japanese hair spa filled with calming treatments and revitalizing masks. Once refreshed, dress her in elegant kimonos, choose delicate accessories, and personalize her look with stunning hairstyles, makeup, and shoes. It's your peaceful retreat into beauty, fashion, and creative expression.

title: Fly and shoot 1. Italian Bosses
description: Nostalgia for 8-bit games. A classic arcade shooter with leveling elements and character selection. Fly and shoot, take down enemies, and blow up and destroy everything in your path. Defeat the boss at the end of each level. Save Laba and earn bonuses for doing so. Each difficulty level is slightly different. Enemies become more aggressive, and the speed increases.

title: Pixel Art
description: With pixel art, paint cubes with the right colors and create pixel art. the right colors and cubes are waiting for you to paint

title: Little Hero Knight
description: In Little Hero Knight, you'll play the role of a brave little hero. Travel through a world full of monsters and keep fighting with your weapon. Build your defense towers and engage in a battle of wits and courage! Strategically manage your battlegrounds, build walls, barracks, houses and more! Build your base and towers using collected coins. Unlock powerful weapons and defense towers, and customize your battle setup!

title: Stickhole.io
description: "Stickhole.io" is a thrilling game with single and two-player modes. In single player, swallow stickman and defeat bosses within time limits. In two-player mode, compete to eat the most stickman, then battle with collected characters. Dynamic gameplay and colorful graphics make it addictive and fun.

title: Turbo Trucks Race
description: Turbo Truck Race, an intense racing game with diverse trucks, unique abilities, and action-packed modes. Experience the adrenaline with realistic graphics, strategic gameplay, and the freedom to explore different landscapes in FreeMap mode. Turbo Truck Race brings a new level of excitement with powerful trucks!

title: Tile Connect Club
description: Tile Connect Club is a brain-training game that tests your linking skills. You have to connect tiles with different pictures in pairs and clear them all within a limited time. You can enjoy various pictures on the tiles, such as animals, fruits, flowers, and more. You can also play faster and faster to become a tile master. Tile Connect Club is a fun and addictive game that challenges your mind and eyes. If you are looking for some tile-connecting action, then download Tile Connect Club now!

title: 99 Balls
description: 99 Balls 3D is an endless arcade game that mixes brick breaker and bubble shooter action in full 3D. Launch balls to smash numbered cylinders before they reach the bottom. Collect stars to unlock fun ball skins like sports balls, gems, or fruit. Simple to play, endlessly challenging, and highly addictive!

title: Snake Classic
description: Snake Classic: A modern twist on the nostalgic snake game. Navigate your snake through six unique modes: Classic, Box, Tunnel, Mill, Condo, and Rail. Collect fruits and gems, customize your snake with skins, and enjoy multi-language support. Compete on personal leaderboards and play on both PC and mobile. Fun and engaging for all ages!

title: Gin Rummy
description: "Gin Rummy" is a classic and engaging card game where the goal is to strategically arrange your hand into sets and runs. Place your cards in either groups of the same rank or in sequential order of the same suit. Score points by eliminating these combinations from your hand. The game ends when a player reaches the target score, typically set at 100 points.

title: Mage's Secret
description: Combine monsters and increase your power by thinking every action. You have to meet monsters, complete more than 100 tasks and learn the secret of the magician.

title: Block Crasher
description: Block Crasher is a fun and fast-paced mix of classic Bubble Shooters, block-breaking games, and a bit of penalty shooting flair. Your goal is to launch colorful bubbles at moving blocks, match the colors, and score as many points as possible. It’s all about timing, precision, and quick thinking as the blocks keep shifting across the screen.

title: Toy Rumble 3d
description: Begin an explosive toy adventure in Toy Rumble 3D. A 3D running and racing arcade game packed with action, speed, and strategy. Move your tank through chaotic obstacle courses, collect parts, assemble your cannon, and shoot your way to victory.

title: Untangle Rings Master
description: This is a simple but addictive ring puzzle game. Do you want to train your brain by solving exciting ring-spinning puzzles? Do you like simple, colorful games with addictive gameplay? Start this free online game and enjoy!

title: Save My Pet
description:
Save My Pet is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you must protect your adorable pet from a swarm of angry bees! Using your creativity, draw a protective barrier around your pet to keep it safe from danger. But be careful, your lines must hold for a few seconds while the bees try to break through! With increasing difficulty, unique challenges, this game will test your problem-solving skills and quick thinking.
Can you keep your pet safe from harm?
Play Save My Pet now and find out!

title: Noob vs Zombie Apocalypse: shooting pro
description:
Post-apocalypse! Noob finds himself alone against zombies. Passing levels, he accumulates coins and picks up weapons.
There is a grenade launcher, a pistol, an uzi, a shotgun, a machine gun, a laser pistol, a rifle, a laser rifle - and so on!

Noob vs Zombie Apocalypse: shooting pro is an epic noob game in the world, similar to minecraft fnaf. Noob shoots at zombies with a variety of weapons like a rambo. Noob miner starts his fighting fnaf survival!

There are 60 levels and 15 bosses in total!

title: Super Pop Blast
description: Get ready for a new kind of brick shooter, with unique mechanics, rewarding challenges, and colorful levels. The object: Clear all the blocks using a limited number of balls. Plan your moves, use the score combo system, and try to get 3 stars!

title: Sticker Puzzle Book
description: Step into the captivating world of Sticker Puzzle, where creativity and strategy come together in a beautifully immersive experience. Explore a vibrant sticker book filled with artistic challenges, visual storytelling, and mind-bending puzzles. Designed as a peaceful chromatic retreat, Sticker Puzzle blends the calming satisfaction of sticker art with the engaging thrill of strategic problem-solving — the perfect harmony of relaxation and mental stimulation.

title: Fun Obby Extreme
description:
Are you ready to experience an extreme game Fun Obby Extreme is a 3D parkour type game, little Obby needs you to help him jump across the platforms and reach the goal of each level.

Explore a sprawling city, level up and unlock new equipment, all while honing your parkour skills along the way!

title: Ragdoll Archers
description: Ragdoll Archers is an archery game featuring bow and arrow-equipped stickmen with ragdoll physics. Fire arrows at a range of opponents while earning points to upgrade your abilities and ammunition.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Draw To Fly
description: Ready for a game that’s as creative as it is challenging? Draw Fly brings your imagination to life, turning simple drawings into pathways to solve puzzles and conquer obstacles. Whether you’re flying past traps or dodging tricky obstacles, this puzzle game will keep you entertained for hours.

title: Air Block
description:
Jump, Place Blocks, and Conquer Challenging Levels!

In Air Block, use quick reflexes and smart block placement to overcome obstacles and enemies. With limited blocks per level, every move counts! Avoid saws, spikes, and unlock doors to progress—plus, grab those bananas if you can!

Game Modes:

Single Player – Test your skills across unique levels.
Two-Player Mode – Compete in quick place challenges and mini-games like Beach Ball, with more to come!
Think you’ve got what it takes? Start now!

title: Math Quest
description: "Math Quest" - an exciting game for the whole family that develops mathematical skills, logic, and reaction speed. Overcome challenges, calculate correct answers, and reach new levels!

title: K-Pop Hunter Fashion
description: Unleash your creativity in K-Pop Hunter Fashion, a unique dress up game where trendy K-Pop meets gothic demon hunter vibes. Style glamorous idols in bold K-Pop looks while blending them with dark, fantasy-inspired outfits. From leather jackets and spiked boots to neon hair, glowing makeup, and mystical accessories—you’ll create fierce, otherworldly fashion statements.

title: Sprunki Puzzles and Singing
description: Before the sprunks take on their immediate duties, namely creating music, you must unlock sixteen characters. In the meantime, you have no one to create your own melodies with. To bring the Sprunki back to life, you must collect an image of each Sprunki. The picture consists of nine square fragments that are mixed on the playing field. Swap them and install them in the correct positions. Having collected all the puzzles, you can start making music in Sprunki Puzzles and Singing.

title: Mighty Run
description: Mighty Run is an action-packed platformer where you jump, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies to progress. Collect gifts along the way and reach the end to grab the diamond, unlocking the next level. Use power-ups, master tricky jumps, and overcome challenges in this thrilling adventure. With smooth controls and exciting gameplay, every level is a test of skill. Can you collect all the rewards and reach the finish line? Play Mighty Run now and prove your skills!

title: Egg Hunt Mania
description: Get your basket ready and save all the eggs you can from a terrible fate. Make sure to empty a full basket into the store. Watch out for the rising quota for eggs each day!

title: Mushroom Fever Match 3
description:
Immerse yourself in the magical forest with Mushroom Fever - Match 3! Bright and cheerful mushrooms replace traditional crystals, adding a fresh twist to the classic match-3 genre. This game will bring you hours of thrilling fun and bursts of excitement!

Match groups of three or more mushrooms, complete engaging tasks, and unlock new levels! Each level brings unique puzzles and fresh challenges. The more matches you make, the more points and bonuses you’ll earn!

title: Manyunya Saving the Princess
description: Welcome to the time when there were knights, magic, farmers, princesses, and generals. Manyunya sets off at the request of the Supreme Lord to save his princess. On the way you will find a whole dangerous adventure, you will come across colorful views, and characters with whom you can communicate and interact, as well as enemies that you will need to defeat at any cost, and save the princess, and complete the task. Interesting voice acting and story will immerse you in this world with your head!

title: Brainrot Boing Boing Merge
description:
Welcome to Brainrot Boing Boing Merge – a charming merge puzzle game where adorable creatures meet polished gameplay and juicy physics!

Merge. Match. Maximize
Satisfying Effects & Lively Details
Unlockable Skins System
Relaxing Yet Strategic

If you love satisfying merges, juicy feedback, and charming characters, this game is for you. Play now and see what creature you’ll create next!

title: Strykon
description:
Strykon is a mobile FPS game with exciting missions and battles. Play different modes like Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Free-for-All, where your goal is to survive.
Choose from many weapons, like pistols, rifles, shotguns, and snipers. Each gun has its own style. Enjoy great graphics, realistic sound, and easy controls. Earn rewards with the Battle Pass to keep the game interesting. Whether you complete missions or fight enemies, this shooter is full of action anytime, anywhere!

title: Tile Hexa Sort
description:
Dive into a world of colorful hexagons where every move requires careful planning. Your goal is to stack identical pieces into tall towers without mixing colors. The higher the tower, the more attention and strategic thinking is needed.

With each new level, more colors and towers appear, making move planning even more important. Think ahead to avoid mistakes and maintain order in the colorful chaos.

title: Homo Evolution
description: Create your own world and guide human evolution! Merge creatures, unlock eight evolution stages, and shape civilization from tiny spores to modern life. Explore new planets, experiment with unique paths, and enjoy endless fun in this captivating evolution game. Play now!
